tools.name: get_canvas_info
tools.title: Get the canvas
tools.description: Reads the canvas: size in pixels and dpi, its origin (where (0, 0) is relative to the canvas it was extended from), bounds (the rectangle the painting covers, in the coordinates every other tool takes), the paper (preset, colour, grain depth), the active layer, the active brush id, the paint colour, the view (zoom, rotation, mirror), the hand, how many strokes are recorded, the undo / redo labels, and the blend modes. Call it first.

tools.name: new_canvas
tools.title: Start a new canvas
tools.description: Replaces the document with a blank canvas: one empty layer over the paper. Size and dpi default to the current ones, the paper to the current paper (or a preset id from list_papers). One undo step (undo brings the old painting back). Returns the new size, paper and layer id.

width.description: Width in pixels (default the current width).

height.description: Height in pixels (default the current height).

dpi.description: Pixels per inch for print sizes and PSD (default the current dpi).

paper.description: Paper preset id from list_papers (default the current paper).

tools.name: set_canvas
tools.title: Resize the canvas
tools.description: Changes the canvas size (pixels stay where they are, anchored at the top-left; anything outside is kept on the layers but not shown) and / or its dpi. One undo step. Returns the canvas.

tools.name: extend_canvas
tools.title: Extend the canvas
tools.description: Grows the canvas by adding pixels on any side, keeping everything painted. Adding on the left or top moves the whole picture (layers, paper grain, guides, stencils, recorded strokes) right or down by that much in document pixels, so coordinates you read before change by (+left, +top). Wet paint stays wet and moves with it when left and top are multiples of 256; otherwise it dries first. One undo step. Returns the canvas, rect (the new canvas in the previous coordinates: x -left, y -top) and origin.

left.description: Pixels to add on the left (default 0).

top.description: Pixels to add on the top (default 0).

right.description: Pixels to add on the right (default 0).

bottom.description: Pixels to add on the bottom (default 0).

tools.name: list_papers
tools.title: List papers
tools.description: Lists the built-in paper library (generated grain, no textures): id, name, family, grain pattern, colour, grain depth and the wet-media properties (absorption, permeability, roughness). Use an id with set_paper or new_canvas.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.title: Get the paper
tools.description: Reads every setting of the current paper (preset, pattern, seed, colour, scale, tiling, depth, shading, dry and wet tuning, absorption, permeability, roughness, and metallic, backlight and backlightColor when set).

tools.name: set_paper
tools.title: Set the paper
tools.description: Changes the paper under the whole painting: a preset from list_papers and / or its settings. Grain depth decides how much grain-responsive brushes (pencil, pastel, charcoal) skip the valleys; changing it re-renders the paper but not strokes already painted. backlight lights the paper from behind (the stained-glass preset has it on). One undo step. Returns the paper.

preset.description: Paper id from list_papers (its settings, then the other fields here on top).

depth.description: Grain depth 0..1 (0: brushes ignore the grain).

scale.description: Grain scale: 1 natural, 2 twice as coarse.

seed.description: Grain seed: another sheet of the same paper.

tiling.description: How the grain tile repeats (mirror hides seams).

shading.description: How much the grain shades the paper colour.

dry.description: Height map tuning for dry media.

wet.description: Height map tuning for wet media (the grain water and pigment follow).

absorption.description: Wet media: how fast the paper soaks up water (high: washes stop spreading sooner).

permeability.description: Wet media: how freely water flows over the fibres (low: more ragged, slower spreading).

roughness.description: Wet media: how much the grain pins wet edges and catches granulating pigment.

metallic.description: Metallic paper (gold or silver leaf, pearlescent card): the grain catches the light (see set_lighting). 0 by default.

backlight.description: Backlit paper (a lightbox, stained glass): light from behind the paper, 0 (none, the default) .. 1. Transparent glazes (watercolour, airbrush, thin marker) glow in their own colour; opaque paint (gouache, oil, solid ink) and thick paint block it; the light through paint spills softly around it. Nothing is repainted.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.title: List layers
tools.description: Lists the layers top first: id, name, type (pixel or group), visibility, opacity, blend, clipping, locks, whether it is active, the painted bounds in document pixels (null when empty), parent and depth.

tools.name: add_layer
tools.title: Add a layer
tools.description: Adds an empty pixel layer, a group, or a stroke layer (type strokes: its strokes stay editable with update_stroke and edit_stroke_points) above the active layer, or above aboveId, or at the top of parentId; it becomes the active layer. One undo step. Returns the layer (liveStrokes: its stroke count, for a stroke layer).

type.description: pixel (default), group, or strokes: a live stroke layer whose pixels are drawn from its strokes, so each stays editable. It takes dab, particle, bristle and Mixer Brush strokes that pick up no paint.

aboveId.description: Put it directly above this layer (default the active layer).

parentId.description: Put it at the top of this group instead.

tools.name: update_layer
tools.title: Change a layer
tools.description: Changes a layer: name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, clipping to the layer below, locks. One undo step. Returns the layer.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers.

opacity.description: Layer opacity 0..1.

blend.description: Blend mode (pass-through for groups only). Painterly modes: watercolor (the layer glazes like a transparent wash), tint (recolours keeping lightness), highlight (adds soft coloured light), shadow (shades with ambient fill); see list_blend_modes.

clipped.description: Clip to the layer below (paint only shows where it has paint).

locks.description: Locks to change (others keep their values).

transparency.description: Paint only where the layer already has paint.

all.description: All of the above, plus property changes and removal.

tools.name: list_blend_modes
tools.title: List blend modes
tools.description: Lists every layer and brush blend mode: id, label, group (standard Photoshop modes, pigment, or painterly), what the pigment and painterly modes do, and the standard mode PSD export writes in their place. Changes nothing. Read it before choosing a painterly mode for update_layer or a brush tip.

tools.name: set_active_layer
tools.title: Choose the active layer
tools.description: Makes a layer active: strokes, fills and clears without a layerId go to it. Editor state, not an undo step. Returns the layer.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers.

tools.name: remove_layer
tools.title: Remove a layer
tools.description: Removes a layer (a group with its children). One undo step. Returns the removed id and the new active layer.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers.

tools.name: duplicate_layer
tools.title: Duplicate a layer
tools.description: Copies a layer (a group with its children) directly above it; the copy becomes active. One undo step. Returns the copy.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers.

tools.name: move_layer
tools.title: Reorder a layer
tools.description: Moves a layer to a position in its group or another (0 is the bottom). One undo step. Returns the layer with its new parent.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers.

index.description: New position among its siblings, 0 = bottom.

parentId.description: Group id to move into, or null for the top level (default its current parent).

tools.name: merge_layer_down
tools.title: Merge a layer down
tools.description: Merges a pixel layer into the pixel layer directly below it, which keeps its name, opacity and blend. One undo step. Returns the merged layer.

layerId.description: The upper layer, from list_layers.

tools.name: fill_layer
tools.title: Fill a layer
tools.description: Fills a whole pixel layer with a colour: a flat block-in, or with grain above 0 a fill that follows the paper grain like pastel or charcoal rubbed across the sheet (pressure decides how far it reaches into the valleys). Good for a ground colour or a tonal layer to paint over. One undo step. Returns the layer id and the filled bounds.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

opacity.description: Opacity 0..1 (default 1).

pressure.description: With grain: how far into the valleys, 0..1 (default 0.5).

blend.description: Blend mode (default normal; pigment mixes like paint, watercolor glazes; see list_blend_modes).

tools.name: fill_region
tools.title: Fill a region (bucket / flats)
tools.description: Flood-fills one or more enclosed regions on a pixel layer from a seed point (x, y) or a batch of seed points (points). Set reference to a line-art layer id from list_layers (or "all" / "composite" for all visible layers, or "layer" for the target layer itself) to drop flat colours onto a flats layer under the ink without touching the line art. closeGap (0..32 px) bridges small gaps in the line art so flats do not leak; expand (-16..16 px, e.g. 1..2 px) bleeds the fill under anti-aliased line edges so no halo shows; wet pours a watercolour wash into the region on the wet layer. One undo step. Returns layerId, bounds, pixelCount, regions, and leaked (true when the fill touched the canvas border).

x.description: Seed point x in document pixels (pass x and y, or points).

y.description: Seed point y in document pixels (pass x and y, or points).

points.description: Multiple seed points in document pixels, filled together as one undo step.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

reference.description: Which pixels stop the fill: "layer" (default, the target layer itself), "all" or "composite" (all visible layers without paper), or a layer id from list_layers (e.g. an ink line-art layer above the flats layer).

opacity.description: Opacity 0..1 (default 1).

blendMode.description: Alias for blend (default normal; see list_blend_modes).

closeGap.description: Close gaps in line art up to this width in pixels, 0..32 (default 0).

expand.description: Expand (> 0, bleed under lines to hide anti-aliased halos) or contract (< 0) the filled region in pixels, -16..16 (default 0).

pressure.description: With grain: how far into the valleys, 0..1 (default 0.5).

wet.description: Pour a wet watercolour wash into the region on the wet layer instead of dry pixels (default false).

tools.name: find_unfilled_regions
tools.title: Find enclosed unfilled regions
tools.description: Finds enclosed unfilled regions from a reference line-art layer (reference: layerId) or the visible composite ("all" / "composite", the default), closing line-art gaps up to closeGap px. When layerId is given, regions already painted on that target layer are excluded. Changes nothing. Returns regions sorted largest first, each with an interior seed point {x, y} ready for fill_region, centroid, bounds, pixelCount (area), and touchesEdge.

layerId.description: Target flats layer id from list_layers; regions already painted on it are excluded (optional).

reference.description: Which pixels define the line-art barriers: "all" or "composite" (default, all visible layers without paper), "layer" (the target or active layer), or a layer id from list_layers (e.g. an ink line-art layer).

tolerance.description: Alpha/colour threshold 0..255 above which a reference pixel counts as line art (default 32).

closeGap.description: Close small gaps in line art up to this width in pixels, 0..32 (default 0).

minArea.description: Ignore regions smaller than this many pixels (default 16).

includeEdge.description: Include regions that touch the canvas border (default false: only enclosed shapes).

maxRegions.description: Most regions to return, largest first (default 100).

tools.name: clear_layer
tools.title: Clear a layer
tools.description: Removes every pixel of a pixel layer. One undo step. Returns the layer id and the bounds that were cleared (null if it was empty).

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: get_brush
tools.title: Get a brush
tools.description: Reads a brush as facets (kind, medium, variety or tool, tip, marks, dynamics, behaviour, light, motion, colour: the brush library's form, as describe_brush returns it), with the engine it paints with and whether it is an unchanged built-in preset. Without id, the active brush as edited. Also returns strokePaint: what a stroke with it would paint now (its gradient colour, else the editor's paint from set_paint). Changes nothing.

id.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (default the active brush).

tools.name: set_brush
tools.title: Set the brush
tools.description: Chooses the active brush (id, from list_brush_presets) and / or changes it with facets laid over it (objects merge, lists and values replace, marks of another kind replace the marks; the brush library's create_brush fields); unset removes whole facets first (unset colour drops a brush's own gradient). Strokes without a brush use it. Editor state, not an undo step: the changes stay on the active brush until the library's create_brush or update_brush stores a brush. Returns the active brush as facets, the engine it paints with, and problems (values clamped or dropped).

id.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets to start from (default the active brush).

description.description: What the brush is for, in a sentence.

items.description: A tag: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

kind.description: mark: lays a material (see medium); tool: works on paint already down (see tool).

medium.description: Marks: what it lays. paint (dry, wet or thick), ink, dry (pencil, pastel, charcoal) or spray (airbrush). Descriptive: the tip, marks and behaviour decide how it renders.

variety.description: What kind of the medium: oil, watercolor, gouache, pencil, pastel, charcoal, airbrush, marker, highlighter… A wet brush whose variety is watercolor, gouache or oil paints that medium.

tool.description: Tools: eraser removes paint; blender mixes the colours under the tip; smudge drags paint along; water lays clear water (lifts dried paint with behaviour.wet.rewet); dryer dries wet paint; blow pushes water along; blot takes wet paint up; wet-blend evens out wet pigment; wet-drag drags wet paint.

tip.description: The tip: its shape and the dab it lays. In a patch, shape may be left out to keep it.

shape.description: round, flat, chisel: an ellipse set by roundness and angle (the name is for people); bristle: a tuft of bristles (see bristle); stamp: dabs shaped like a stamp, a sticker or an image source (see stamps), also laid as sprays, objects or particles.

size.description: Diameter in px (default 20).

hardness.description: Edge hardness, 0 soft .. 1 hard (default 1). Image-source stamps fade towards their edges below 1.

spacing.description: Dab spacing as a fraction of the diameter: 0.05 smooth, 1 dotted (default 0.1).

angle.description: Tip angle in degrees, counter-clockwise; added to the stroke direction or barrel with dynamics.rotation (default 0).

roundness.description: Roundness: 1 round (default), lower a flat ellipse (pastel, chisel).

opacity.description: Stroke opacity ceiling: overlapping dabs never exceed it (default 1).

flow.description: Build-up per dab towards the opacity: low flow builds softly, like an airbrush (default 1).

blend.description: How the stroke paints onto the layer (default normal). pigment mixes like real paint; multiply darkens like marker ink; watercolor glazes; tint, highlight and shadow recolour, light and shade.

bristle.description: Bristle tips: the tuft. Missing fields take their defaults.

count.description: Bristles in the tuft (default 32).

stiffness.description: Stiff bristles follow the tip; soft ones lag and bend into curves at turns (default 0.5).

splay.description: How far pressure spreads the tuft (default 0.5).

thickness.description: Each bristle's line width as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.06).

load.description: Paint per bristle: 1 never runs dry; lower, bristles run out along the stroke, a dry brush (default 0.6).

jitter.description: Random variation between bristles: length, paint, position (default 0.4).

items.description: A sticker ref provider:id (find_stickers lists them; the editor's own are editor:dot, editor:star, editor:heart, editor:leaf, editor:flower, editor:confetti, editor:splat, editor:sparkle, editor:ring), or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources lists them; add_brush_source makes one from an image). A bare editor stamp (star) means editor:star.

stamps.description: Stamp tips: stickers or image sources (source:<id>). Continuous dabs and sprays lay the first; objects take only stickers and pick one at random per mark (default editor:star; repeats count once); particles use the first 4 in marks.stampOrder, and repeats weight the order.

grain.description: Texture inside the tip (a grain source), separate from the paper's grain: each dab is multiplied by it. Continuous and scatter marks of round and stamp tips.

source.description: The texture: a built-in pattern (cold-pressed, hot-pressed, rough, vellum, laid, ingres, sanded, canvas, linen, gesso) or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources); light parts are peaks, which paint.

mode.description: texturised (default): the grain stays put on the canvas, a texture under the paint; moving: it rolls along with the tip, turning with it.

scale.description: Grain size: 1 is the pattern's or image's own size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How much the grain takes out of each dab: 0 none, 1 only the peaks paint (default 0.6).

contrast.description: Height contrast around the middle: below 1 softer, above 1 harsher (default 1).

marks.description: How the tip is laid along the path (default continuous): continuous dabs, a scatter of spray droplets, particles, or objects (editable stickers).

oneOf.description: Dabs laid along the path (the default).
A spray (a spray can): each dab lays a seeded scatter of droplets across the tip; jitter and size come from dynamics and the tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

size.description: Droplet size as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.12).

oneOf.description: Particles that move with the pen and draw as they go. Missing fields take their defaults.

physics.description: How the particles move (default spring). string: strands dragged behind the pen (hair, fur); spring: on springs to the pen, overshooting; orbit: circling the pen (curls); flow: thrown into a swirling flow until they fade; elastic: links that stretch and snap back; fuzzy: winding strings waving out of step.

render.description: How they draw (default line). dot: a mark per step; line: a continuous line each; sequence: beads spaced along each path; ribbon: the band between neighbouring paths filled.

count.description: Particles (flow: thrown per tip of travel). Default 12.

size.description: Mark size as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its edge width (default 0.08).

spread.description: How far apart they start, as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its width (default 0.5).

stiffness.description: Spring, string and elastic stiffness: stiff follows closely, soft swings wide (default 0.4).

life.description: Flow particles: how long they live (default 0.5).

ribbonFill.description: Ribbon: fill opacity between the paths, relative to their edges (default 0.5; 0 only edges).

ribbonPairs.description: Ribbon: adjacent (default) joins each particle to its neighbour; first-last makes one band between the outermost two.

waveAmplitude.description: Wave: sideways swing as a fraction of the tip size (default 0: no wave).

waveLength.description: Wave: wavelength in px of pen travel (default 60).

wavePhaseJitter.description: Wave: how far out of step the particles' waves are; 0 in step, 1 random phases (default 0).

stampOrder.description: Stamp tips: sequence (default) uses the stamps in turn; random picks one per dot, seeded.

stampRotation.description: Stamp tips: follow turns each with its particle's motion; random (default); fixed uses the tip angle.

oneOf.description: Each mark stays an editable object (a sticker) on a sticker layer; needs a stamp tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

density.description: About density × 4 marks per tip diameter of travel; 0.25 ≈ one per diameter (default 0.4).

rotationJitter.description: Random turn as a fraction of ±180° (default 1).

scatter.description: How far from the path marks land, in tip diameters (default 0.5).

colourJitter.description: Random colour change: at 1 up to ±40° of hue and ±0.15 OKLab lightness (default 0.2).

dynamics.description: Pen feel: pressure, tilt, velocity, jitter, rotation and smoothing. Every amount 0 (off) .. 1 unless noted; missing fields take their defaults.

pressureSize.description: Pressure scales the size, down to minSize (default true).

pressureSmoothing.description: Pressure smoothing, separate from position smoothing (default 0).

rotation.description: What turns the tip: fixed (tip.angle, default), stroke (direction of travel) or barrel (pen barrel rotation).

minSize.description: Size at zero pressure as a fraction of the full size, with pressureSize (default 0).

tiltSize.description: Laying the pen down widens the tip, up to 2.5× (default 0).

tiltRoundness.description: Laying the pen down flattens the tip along the tilt, side-of-the-pencil shading (default 0).

tiltOpacity.description: Laying the pen down lightens the mark (default 0).

velocitySize.description: Positive grows the tip on fast strokes, negative thins it; needs timed points (default 0).

velocityOpacity.description: Positive darkens fast marks, negative lightens them; needs timed points (default 0).

angleJitter.description: Random angle per dab, as a fraction of ±180° (default 0).

scatter.description: Random offset across the stroke, in diameters (default 0).

count.description: Dabs laid at each spacing step, each with its own jitter and scatter (default 1). Dab brushes.

flip.description: Mirror each dab at random across x, y or both (default none): variety for image and stamp tips.

behaviour.description: What the material does on the surface, and how tools work. Missing fields take their defaults.

surface.description: dry (default): stays where it lands; wet: flows, pools and dries (see wet); thick: stands up in relief (see thick).

grain.description: Paper grain response: 0 ignores the grain, 1 catches only its peaks at light pressure (pencil, pastel, charcoal). Default 0.

mixing.description: How colours mix: pigment (Kubelka-Munk, blue and yellow make green) or rgb (straight averages). Default pigment; a Mixer Brush and the smudge tool default to rgb.

exchange.description: Paint exchange with the canvas: picking up paint and mixing it into what the brush lays. Paint brushes on a dry, wet or thick surface and Mixer Brushes.

pickup.description: Pick-up ratio: how much of the paint under each dab the brush lifts and carries (default 0; with a reservoir 0.5).

mix.description: Mix ratio: how much of the carried paint goes into what the brush lays, against its own colour (default 0.5).

dirty.description: Keep the carried paint after the stroke, so the next one starts with the last colour touched (default false).

reservoir.description: A paint reservoir makes this a Mixer Brush (an empty object takes every default).

load.description: How much paint the reservoir holds; below 1 it drains per dab and long strokes run dry (default 0.5).

refill.description: Refill with the paint colour before each stroke (default true).

loadsColour.description: Load the current colour at all (default true; false: it only moves paint already down).

wet.description: Wet surface (watercolour, gouache, wet oil) and the wet tools. Missing fields take their defaults.

medium.description: The wet medium; a layer takes the medium's wet settings the first time it holds wet paint (default: the variety when it is watercolor, gouache or oil, else watercolor).

water.description: Wetness: water laid, 0.2 a damp brush .. 1 dripping (default 0.5).

pigment.description: Pigment concentration: 0 clear water .. 1 straight from the tube (default 0.5).

rewet.description: How much dried paint the water lifts again: 0 staining (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the brush runs dry along a long stroke (default 1).

thinner.description: Thinner (water or solvent): more transparent, runnier paint (default 0).

thick.description: Thick surface (impasto: paint with relief, lit by the canvas lighting). Missing fields take their defaults.

applicator.description: What lays the paint (default brush). brush: bristle ridges; tube: blobs squeezed from the tube; knife: scrapes the relief flat and smears; roller: a flat stippled band; gloop: a thick glossy bead.

thickness.description: How far the paint stands up (default 0.6).

metallic.description: Metallic: highlights take the paint colour, gold, copper, silver (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the stroke thins as the brush empties (default 0.9).

drag.description: Knife and brush: how much of the paint under the tool is dragged along (default 0.4).

rim.description: Light paint: light is stronger where the bead turns away, as on backlit glass (default 0).

clarity.description: Glassy paint: the middle of a bead lets the layers below show through (default 0).

strength.description: Tools: how strongly the blender, smudge or wet tool works per dab (default 0.5; smudge 0.7).

distance.description: Blender: how far away colours are mixed in, as a fraction of the tip diameter (default 0.35).

length.description: Smudge: how far paint is dragged, the share of carried paint kept per dab (default 0.85).

light.description: Light the brush gives off with its colour (glow and spill). Give light brushes dark paper.

amount.description: Light per dab, scaled by its coverage and flow (default 0: none).

spill.description: Suggested spill for the layer, applied when it has none of its own.

radius.description: How far the light reaches, px; 0 turns spill off (a highlighter).

glow.description: Suggest a glow layer effect for the layer (glow stays a layer effect).

fluorescence.description: UV-fluorescent ink: glows in its colour under the virtual UV blacklight (set_uv_light); invisible in normal light when invisible is true.

amount.description: Fluorescence intensity under UV blacklight, 0 (none) .. 1.

invisible.description: Invisible ink in normal light: lays no daylight paint and glows only under UV (default false).

thermochromic.description: Thermochromic ink: shifts smoothly toward hotColor where the canvas heat field warms it past threshold.

hotColor.description: Colour (#rrggbb) the ink turns when heated.

threshold.description: Temperature 0.05..0.95 at which the colour shift is halfway (default 0.5).

iridescence.description: Structural colour: a thin dielectric film over the paint whose interference hue shifts with the light and view tilt. Missing fields take their defaults.

thickness.description: Film thickness in nanometres, 100..1000 (default 400).

pressureToThickness.description: How much pen pressure shifts the film thickness per dab, 0..1 (default 0: uniform thickness).

ior.description: Refractive index of the film, 1.2..2.0 (default 1.5; water/soap ~1.33, pearl ~1.55, beetle lacquer ~1.65).

ghost.description: Ghost paint: wet paint that flows and mixes visibly while wet, then fades away without leaving its colour, keeping only the smear it made in the paint it touched (needs behaviour.surface "wet").

linger.description: Seconds of simulated time before the ghost paint has fully faded (default 4).

smear.description: How much the ghost paint drags and lifts the paint it passes through: 0 none .. 1 full (default 0.3).

trigger.description: When the fade starts: immediate (default) counts down as soon as the paint is laid; agent holds the fade until read_mutation claims the stroke.

mutation.description: Mutation paint: you paint something and pause; once an agent claims it with read_mutation, your paint sinks away and the agent paints its own answer (any wet or dry paint brush that lays its own colour without reading paint beneath).

settle.description: Seconds after the last stroke before it counts as finished and raises a mutation request (default 1.5).

patience.description: Seconds to wait for an agent before giving up and keeping the paint as ordinary paint (default 45).

fade.description: Seconds the paint takes to sink away once claimed by read_mutation (default 2).

ferro.description: Liquid ferrofluid paint: 0..1 (amount), or { amount, wavelength, threshold }. Rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

anyOf.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (0..1).
Liquid ferrofluid paint: rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

amount.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (default 0: none).

threshold.description: Critical magnetic field |B| threshold where spikes begin to rise (default 0.12).

live.description: Effect paint keeps playing on stroke layers (default false).

fps.description: Suggested playback rate in frames per second.

waveSpeed.description: Particle waves: how fast they run by stroke time; 0 they stand still (default 0), 1 about four a second.

livePatterns.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterns (spots, stripes, coral, maze, worms) that grow inside wet paint (behaviour.surface: wet) and freeze where the paint dries.

pattern.description: Named Pearson feed/kill preset: spots (default, dividing mitosis spots), stripes (labyrinthine stripes), coral (branching dendrites), maze (winding channels) or worms (vermicular tracks).

feed.description: Gray-Scott feed rate F (0.01..0.1; default from pattern).

kill.description: Gray-Scott kill rate k (0.03..0.08; default from pattern).

scale.description: Spatial scale of the pattern (diffusion multiplier, 0.5..4, default 1).

contrast.description: Visual contrast of the V concentration field (0..2, default 1).

secondColor.description: Optional second colour (#rrggbb) that V blends the wet paint towards; null or omitted modulates pigment density/contrast.

relief.description: Impasto relief height written to the layer thick map as patterns grow (0..1, default 0).

colour.description: The brush's colours. The user's colour still wins unless own is set.

default.description: The colour the brush starts with. A gradient is always painted (its paint / secondary stops take the user's colours); a solid colour or effect paint is suggested to the host.

anyOf.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).
A colour for each colour scheme; the host picks one when the stroke starts and records it.

light.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).

tools.name: set_color
tools.title: Set the paint colour
tools.description: Sets the paint colour (and optionally the second colour) that strokes and fills use by default, and whether it is locked. Choosing a brush with a default colour (set_brush id, e.g. the highlighter's yellow) makes that the paint colour unless the colour is locked; a brush with colour.own always paints its own. Setting color goes back to one colour from gradient paint (set_paint) or effect paint (set_effect_paint). dualColor sets a light / dark pair instead: strokes paint the side of the host's colour scheme and record the pair, and strokes on a stroke layer are redrawn in the other side when the scheme changes (pixel layers keep their pixels). Editor state, not an undo step. Returns both colours and locked (and dualColor when given).

Gradient paint: 2..16 stops sorted by offset (#rrggbb, or "paint" / "secondary" for the two editor colours), space pigment (default: mixes like paint) / oklab / srgb, and map: distance (default: the colour changes as the stroke is dragged out, 300 px then mirrored back), pressure, tilt, velocity, direction, time, across-tip or random. Every stroking brush samples it per dab (dab, mixer, watercolour and gouache, oil and impasto, particle, bristle, sticker); erasers, blenders and smudges ignore it, and a brush with its own gradient (get_brush paint) paints that instead. It also ends effect paint (set_effect_paint); set_color goes back to one colour. Editor state, not an undo step. Returns paint, color and secondaryColor.

tools.name: paint_stroke
tools.title: Paint a brush stroke
tools.description: Paints one stroke through points (document pixels, with optional pressure, time, tilt and barrel rotation) on a pixel layer of the canvas with a library brush or the active one, optionally changed (by facets) for this stroke. Grain-responsive brushes follow the paper; the mixer engine (mixer-brush) picks up and mixes paint already on the layer, the blender mixes nearby colours, the smudge drags paint, and dab brushes with behavior.pickup lift and carry paint, and wet brushes (engine wet: watercolour, gouache, add water, dry, blow, wet blend, wet smudge, blot) paint on the layer’s wet layer, where the paint keeps moving until it dries (the result says wet: true while it is; see advance_wet_paint and dry_paint; a dry brush on wet paint dries it first; wet oil brushes blend into the wet oil they meet; with light.amount, as glow-wash has, their light flows with the paint), impasto brushes (engine impasto: impasto brush, paint tube, palette knife, roller, gloop pen, metallic paint) lay thick paint whose relief is lit by set_lighting, particle and bristle brushes draw procedural marks, and sticker brushes spray editable stickers onto an empty or sticker layer (list_stickers). Guide stencils make strokes that start near them follow them; mask stencils keep paint inside them. The symmetry guide adds its mirror copies; with a tracing image that samples colours, a stroke without color takes the image colour at its first point. With an agent cursor (a director), the stroke is painted live along the points at the pace of their times. One undo step. Returns the layer id, changed bounds, dab count, the recorded strokeId (for replay_strokes), for wet brushes wet (paint still wet) and, for brushes that pick up paint, mixerLoad: what the brush carries after the stroke.

points.description: The path in document pixels (raw samples; the brush smooths them). One point paints one dab.

t.description: Time in milliseconds (optional; drives velocity dynamics, e.g. an ink pen thinning on fast strokes).

tiltX.description: Pen tilt in degrees towards +x (Pointer Events tiltX).

tiltY.description: Pen tilt in degrees towards +y (Pointer Events tiltY).

altitude.description: Pen altitude in radians: 1.5708 upright, 0 lying flat (overrides tiltX / tiltY).

azimuth.description: Where the pen leans, radians clockwise from +x (with altitude).

twist.description: Barrel rotation in degrees (brushes with rotation barrel).

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

brushId.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (default the active brush).

brush.description: Facets to change for this stroke only, laid over brushId or the active brush (as set_brush takes them).

description.description: What the brush is for, in a sentence.

items.description: A tag: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

kind.description: mark: lays a material (see medium); tool: works on paint already down (see tool).

medium.description: Marks: what it lays. paint (dry, wet or thick), ink, dry (pencil, pastel, charcoal) or spray (airbrush). Descriptive: the tip, marks and behaviour decide how it renders.

variety.description: What kind of the medium: oil, watercolor, gouache, pencil, pastel, charcoal, airbrush, marker, highlighter… A wet brush whose variety is watercolor, gouache or oil paints that medium.

tool.description: Tools: eraser removes paint; blender mixes the colours under the tip; smudge drags paint along; water lays clear water (lifts dried paint with behaviour.wet.rewet); dryer dries wet paint; blow pushes water along; blot takes wet paint up; wet-blend evens out wet pigment; wet-drag drags wet paint.

tip.description: The tip: its shape and the dab it lays. In a patch, shape may be left out to keep it.

shape.description: round, flat, chisel: an ellipse set by roundness and angle (the name is for people); bristle: a tuft of bristles (see bristle); stamp: dabs shaped like a stamp, a sticker or an image source (see stamps), also laid as sprays, objects or particles.

size.description: Diameter in px (default 20).

hardness.description: Edge hardness, 0 soft .. 1 hard (default 1). Image-source stamps fade towards their edges below 1.

spacing.description: Dab spacing as a fraction of the diameter: 0.05 smooth, 1 dotted (default 0.1).

angle.description: Tip angle in degrees, counter-clockwise; added to the stroke direction or barrel with dynamics.rotation (default 0).

roundness.description: Roundness: 1 round (default), lower a flat ellipse (pastel, chisel).

opacity.description: Stroke opacity ceiling: overlapping dabs never exceed it (default 1).

flow.description: Build-up per dab towards the opacity: low flow builds softly, like an airbrush (default 1).

blend.description: How the stroke paints onto the layer (default normal). pigment mixes like real paint; multiply darkens like marker ink; watercolor glazes; tint, highlight and shadow recolour, light and shade.

bristle.description: Bristle tips: the tuft. Missing fields take their defaults.

count.description: Bristles in the tuft (default 32).

stiffness.description: Stiff bristles follow the tip; soft ones lag and bend into curves at turns (default 0.5).

splay.description: How far pressure spreads the tuft (default 0.5).

thickness.description: Each bristle's line width as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.06).

load.description: Paint per bristle: 1 never runs dry; lower, bristles run out along the stroke, a dry brush (default 0.6).

jitter.description: Random variation between bristles: length, paint, position (default 0.4).

items.description: A sticker ref provider:id (find_stickers lists them; the editor's own are editor:dot, editor:star, editor:heart, editor:leaf, editor:flower, editor:confetti, editor:splat, editor:sparkle, editor:ring), or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources lists them; add_brush_source makes one from an image). A bare editor stamp (star) means editor:star.

stamps.description: Stamp tips: stickers or image sources (source:<id>). Continuous dabs and sprays lay the first; objects take only stickers and pick one at random per mark (default editor:star; repeats count once); particles use the first 4 in marks.stampOrder, and repeats weight the order.

grain.description: Texture inside the tip (a grain source), separate from the paper's grain: each dab is multiplied by it. Continuous and scatter marks of round and stamp tips.

source.description: The texture: a built-in pattern (cold-pressed, hot-pressed, rough, vellum, laid, ingres, sanded, canvas, linen, gesso) or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources); light parts are peaks, which paint.

mode.description: texturised (default): the grain stays put on the canvas, a texture under the paint; moving: it rolls along with the tip, turning with it.

scale.description: Grain size: 1 is the pattern's or image's own size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How much the grain takes out of each dab: 0 none, 1 only the peaks paint (default 0.6).

contrast.description: Height contrast around the middle: below 1 softer, above 1 harsher (default 1).

marks.description: How the tip is laid along the path (default continuous): continuous dabs, a scatter of spray droplets, particles, or objects (editable stickers).

oneOf.description: Dabs laid along the path (the default).
A spray (a spray can): each dab lays a seeded scatter of droplets across the tip; jitter and size come from dynamics and the tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

size.description: Droplet size as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.12).

oneOf.description: Particles that move with the pen and draw as they go. Missing fields take their defaults.

physics.description: How the particles move (default spring). string: strands dragged behind the pen (hair, fur); spring: on springs to the pen, overshooting; orbit: circling the pen (curls); flow: thrown into a swirling flow until they fade; elastic: links that stretch and snap back; fuzzy: winding strings waving out of step.

render.description: How they draw (default line). dot: a mark per step; line: a continuous line each; sequence: beads spaced along each path; ribbon: the band between neighbouring paths filled.

count.description: Particles (flow: thrown per tip of travel). Default 12.

size.description: Mark size as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its edge width (default 0.08).

spread.description: How far apart they start, as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its width (default 0.5).

stiffness.description: Spring, string and elastic stiffness: stiff follows closely, soft swings wide (default 0.4).

life.description: Flow particles: how long they live (default 0.5).

ribbonFill.description: Ribbon: fill opacity between the paths, relative to their edges (default 0.5; 0 only edges).

ribbonPairs.description: Ribbon: adjacent (default) joins each particle to its neighbour; first-last makes one band between the outermost two.

waveAmplitude.description: Wave: sideways swing as a fraction of the tip size (default 0: no wave).

waveLength.description: Wave: wavelength in px of pen travel (default 60).

wavePhaseJitter.description: Wave: how far out of step the particles' waves are; 0 in step, 1 random phases (default 0).

stampOrder.description: Stamp tips: sequence (default) uses the stamps in turn; random picks one per dot, seeded.

stampRotation.description: Stamp tips: follow turns each with its particle's motion; random (default); fixed uses the tip angle.

oneOf.description: Each mark stays an editable object (a sticker) on a sticker layer; needs a stamp tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

density.description: About density × 4 marks per tip diameter of travel; 0.25 ≈ one per diameter (default 0.4).

rotationJitter.description: Random turn as a fraction of ±180° (default 1).

scatter.description: How far from the path marks land, in tip diameters (default 0.5).

colourJitter.description: Random colour change: at 1 up to ±40° of hue and ±0.15 OKLab lightness (default 0.2).

dynamics.description: Pen feel: pressure, tilt, velocity, jitter, rotation and smoothing. Every amount 0 (off) .. 1 unless noted; missing fields take their defaults.

pressureSize.description: Pressure scales the size, down to minSize (default true).

pressureSmoothing.description: Pressure smoothing, separate from position smoothing (default 0).

rotation.description: What turns the tip: fixed (tip.angle, default), stroke (direction of travel) or barrel (pen barrel rotation).

minSize.description: Size at zero pressure as a fraction of the full size, with pressureSize (default 0).

tiltSize.description: Laying the pen down widens the tip, up to 2.5× (default 0).

tiltRoundness.description: Laying the pen down flattens the tip along the tilt, side-of-the-pencil shading (default 0).

tiltOpacity.description: Laying the pen down lightens the mark (default 0).

velocitySize.description: Positive grows the tip on fast strokes, negative thins it; needs timed points (default 0).

velocityOpacity.description: Positive darkens fast marks, negative lightens them; needs timed points (default 0).

angleJitter.description: Random angle per dab, as a fraction of ±180° (default 0).

scatter.description: Random offset across the stroke, in diameters (default 0).

count.description: Dabs laid at each spacing step, each with its own jitter and scatter (default 1). Dab brushes.

flip.description: Mirror each dab at random across x, y or both (default none): variety for image and stamp tips.

behaviour.description: What the material does on the surface, and how tools work. Missing fields take their defaults.

surface.description: dry (default): stays where it lands; wet: flows, pools and dries (see wet); thick: stands up in relief (see thick).

grain.description: Paper grain response: 0 ignores the grain, 1 catches only its peaks at light pressure (pencil, pastel, charcoal). Default 0.

mixing.description: How colours mix: pigment (Kubelka-Munk, blue and yellow make green) or rgb (straight averages). Default pigment; a Mixer Brush and the smudge tool default to rgb.

exchange.description: Paint exchange with the canvas: picking up paint and mixing it into what the brush lays. Paint brushes on a dry, wet or thick surface and Mixer Brushes.

pickup.description: Pick-up ratio: how much of the paint under each dab the brush lifts and carries (default 0; with a reservoir 0.5).

mix.description: Mix ratio: how much of the carried paint goes into what the brush lays, against its own colour (default 0.5).

dirty.description: Keep the carried paint after the stroke, so the next one starts with the last colour touched (default false).

reservoir.description: A paint reservoir makes this a Mixer Brush (an empty object takes every default).

load.description: How much paint the reservoir holds; below 1 it drains per dab and long strokes run dry (default 0.5).

refill.description: Refill with the paint colour before each stroke (default true).

loadsColour.description: Load the current colour at all (default true; false: it only moves paint already down).

wet.description: Wet surface (watercolour, gouache, wet oil) and the wet tools. Missing fields take their defaults.

medium.description: The wet medium; a layer takes the medium's wet settings the first time it holds wet paint (default: the variety when it is watercolor, gouache or oil, else watercolor).

water.description: Wetness: water laid, 0.2 a damp brush .. 1 dripping (default 0.5).

pigment.description: Pigment concentration: 0 clear water .. 1 straight from the tube (default 0.5).

rewet.description: How much dried paint the water lifts again: 0 staining (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the brush runs dry along a long stroke (default 1).

thinner.description: Thinner (water or solvent): more transparent, runnier paint (default 0).

thick.description: Thick surface (impasto: paint with relief, lit by the canvas lighting). Missing fields take their defaults.

applicator.description: What lays the paint (default brush). brush: bristle ridges; tube: blobs squeezed from the tube; knife: scrapes the relief flat and smears; roller: a flat stippled band; gloop: a thick glossy bead.

thickness.description: How far the paint stands up (default 0.6).

metallic.description: Metallic: highlights take the paint colour, gold, copper, silver (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the stroke thins as the brush empties (default 0.9).

drag.description: Knife and brush: how much of the paint under the tool is dragged along (default 0.4).

rim.description: Light paint: light is stronger where the bead turns away, as on backlit glass (default 0).

clarity.description: Glassy paint: the middle of a bead lets the layers below show through (default 0).

strength.description: Tools: how strongly the blender, smudge or wet tool works per dab (default 0.5; smudge 0.7).

distance.description: Blender: how far away colours are mixed in, as a fraction of the tip diameter (default 0.35).

length.description: Smudge: how far paint is dragged, the share of carried paint kept per dab (default 0.85).

light.description: Light the brush gives off with its colour (glow and spill). Give light brushes dark paper.

amount.description: Light per dab, scaled by its coverage and flow (default 0: none).

spill.description: Suggested spill for the layer, applied when it has none of its own.

radius.description: How far the light reaches, px; 0 turns spill off (a highlighter).

glow.description: Suggest a glow layer effect for the layer (glow stays a layer effect).

fluorescence.description: UV-fluorescent ink: glows in its colour under the virtual UV blacklight (set_uv_light); invisible in normal light when invisible is true.

amount.description: Fluorescence intensity under UV blacklight, 0 (none) .. 1.

invisible.description: Invisible ink in normal light: lays no daylight paint and glows only under UV (default false).

thermochromic.description: Thermochromic ink: shifts smoothly toward hotColor where the canvas heat field warms it past threshold.

hotColor.description: Colour (#rrggbb) the ink turns when heated.

threshold.description: Temperature 0.05..0.95 at which the colour shift is halfway (default 0.5).

iridescence.description: Structural colour: a thin dielectric film over the paint whose interference hue shifts with the light and view tilt. Missing fields take their defaults.

thickness.description: Film thickness in nanometres, 100..1000 (default 400).

pressureToThickness.description: How much pen pressure shifts the film thickness per dab, 0..1 (default 0: uniform thickness).

ior.description: Refractive index of the film, 1.2..2.0 (default 1.5; water/soap ~1.33, pearl ~1.55, beetle lacquer ~1.65).

ghost.description: Ghost paint: wet paint that flows and mixes visibly while wet, then fades away without leaving its colour, keeping only the smear it made in the paint it touched (needs behaviour.surface "wet").

linger.description: Seconds of simulated time before the ghost paint has fully faded (default 4).

smear.description: How much the ghost paint drags and lifts the paint it passes through: 0 none .. 1 full (default 0.3).

trigger.description: When the fade starts: immediate (default) counts down as soon as the paint is laid; agent holds the fade until read_mutation claims the stroke.

mutation.description: Mutation paint: you paint something and pause; once an agent claims it with read_mutation, your paint sinks away and the agent paints its own answer (any wet or dry paint brush that lays its own colour without reading paint beneath).

settle.description: Seconds after the last stroke before it counts as finished and raises a mutation request (default 1.5).

patience.description: Seconds to wait for an agent before giving up and keeping the paint as ordinary paint (default 45).

fade.description: Seconds the paint takes to sink away once claimed by read_mutation (default 2).

ferro.description: Liquid ferrofluid paint: 0..1 (amount), or { amount, wavelength, threshold }. Rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

anyOf.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (0..1).
Liquid ferrofluid paint: rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

amount.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (default 0: none).

threshold.description: Critical magnetic field |B| threshold where spikes begin to rise (default 0.12).

live.description: Effect paint keeps playing on stroke layers (default false).

fps.description: Suggested playback rate in frames per second.

waveSpeed.description: Particle waves: how fast they run by stroke time; 0 they stand still (default 0), 1 about four a second.

livePatterns.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterns (spots, stripes, coral, maze, worms) that grow inside wet paint (behaviour.surface: wet) and freeze where the paint dries.

pattern.description: Named Pearson feed/kill preset: spots (default, dividing mitosis spots), stripes (labyrinthine stripes), coral (branching dendrites), maze (winding channels) or worms (vermicular tracks).

feed.description: Gray-Scott feed rate F (0.01..0.1; default from pattern).

kill.description: Gray-Scott kill rate k (0.03..0.08; default from pattern).

scale.description: Spatial scale of the pattern (diffusion multiplier, 0.5..4, default 1).

contrast.description: Visual contrast of the V concentration field (0..2, default 1).

tools.name: stroke_path
tools.title: Brush along a path
tools.description: Brushes vector path data (SVG path d in document pixels: M, L, H, V, C, S, Q, T, A and Z) on a pixel layer with a library brush or the active one, as if drawn by hand along it: the outline of a shape, a lettering guide, a curve from a vector tool. Each subpath becomes one recorded stroke, sampled every spacing px, with an optional pressure profile spread along each subpath (a taper such as [0.2, 1, 0.2]); closed subpaths end where they start. Brushes behave as in paint_stroke (grain, pick-up, wet and thick paint, guides off). With an agent cursor (a director), each subpath is painted live in turn. One undo step for the whole path. Returns the layer id, changed bounds, dab count and the recorded strokeIds (for replay_strokes, update_stroke).

path.description: SVG path data in document pixels, e.g. "M 40 200 C 120 40 280 40 360 200". Several subpaths paint several strokes.

spacing.description: Distance between samples along the path in document pixels (default 2); the brush spaces its own dabs, so this only sets how closely curves are followed.

pressure.description: Pen pressure along each subpath, spread evenly from start to end (default full pressure); [0.2, 1, 0.2] tapers both ends.

speed.description: Drawing speed in document pixels per millisecond (optional; gives each sample a time t so playback has a pace and speed-sensitive brushes respond).

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

brushId.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (default the active brush).

brush.description: Facets to change for this stroke only, laid over brushId or the active brush (as set_brush takes them).

description.description: What the brush is for, in a sentence.

items.description: A tag: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

kind.description: mark: lays a material (see medium); tool: works on paint already down (see tool).

medium.description: Marks: what it lays. paint (dry, wet or thick), ink, dry (pencil, pastel, charcoal) or spray (airbrush). Descriptive: the tip, marks and behaviour decide how it renders.

variety.description: What kind of the medium: oil, watercolor, gouache, pencil, pastel, charcoal, airbrush, marker, highlighter… A wet brush whose variety is watercolor, gouache or oil paints that medium.

tool.description: Tools: eraser removes paint; blender mixes the colours under the tip; smudge drags paint along; water lays clear water (lifts dried paint with behaviour.wet.rewet); dryer dries wet paint; blow pushes water along; blot takes wet paint up; wet-blend evens out wet pigment; wet-drag drags wet paint.

tip.description: The tip: its shape and the dab it lays. In a patch, shape may be left out to keep it.

shape.description: round, flat, chisel: an ellipse set by roundness and angle (the name is for people); bristle: a tuft of bristles (see bristle); stamp: dabs shaped like a stamp, a sticker or an image source (see stamps), also laid as sprays, objects or particles.

size.description: Diameter in px (default 20).

hardness.description: Edge hardness, 0 soft .. 1 hard (default 1). Image-source stamps fade towards their edges below 1.

spacing.description: Dab spacing as a fraction of the diameter: 0.05 smooth, 1 dotted (default 0.1).

angle.description: Tip angle in degrees, counter-clockwise; added to the stroke direction or barrel with dynamics.rotation (default 0).

roundness.description: Roundness: 1 round (default), lower a flat ellipse (pastel, chisel).

opacity.description: Stroke opacity ceiling: overlapping dabs never exceed it (default 1).

flow.description: Build-up per dab towards the opacity: low flow builds softly, like an airbrush (default 1).

blend.description: How the stroke paints onto the layer (default normal). pigment mixes like real paint; multiply darkens like marker ink; watercolor glazes; tint, highlight and shadow recolour, light and shade.

bristle.description: Bristle tips: the tuft. Missing fields take their defaults.

count.description: Bristles in the tuft (default 32).

stiffness.description: Stiff bristles follow the tip; soft ones lag and bend into curves at turns (default 0.5).

splay.description: How far pressure spreads the tuft (default 0.5).

thickness.description: Each bristle's line width as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.06).

load.description: Paint per bristle: 1 never runs dry; lower, bristles run out along the stroke, a dry brush (default 0.6).

jitter.description: Random variation between bristles: length, paint, position (default 0.4).

items.description: A sticker ref provider:id (find_stickers lists them; the editor's own are editor:dot, editor:star, editor:heart, editor:leaf, editor:flower, editor:confetti, editor:splat, editor:sparkle, editor:ring), or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources lists them; add_brush_source makes one from an image). A bare editor stamp (star) means editor:star.

stamps.description: Stamp tips: stickers or image sources (source:<id>). Continuous dabs and sprays lay the first; objects take only stickers and pick one at random per mark (default editor:star; repeats count once); particles use the first 4 in marks.stampOrder, and repeats weight the order.

grain.description: Texture inside the tip (a grain source), separate from the paper's grain: each dab is multiplied by it. Continuous and scatter marks of round and stamp tips.

source.description: The texture: a built-in pattern (cold-pressed, hot-pressed, rough, vellum, laid, ingres, sanded, canvas, linen, gesso) or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources); light parts are peaks, which paint.

mode.description: texturised (default): the grain stays put on the canvas, a texture under the paint; moving: it rolls along with the tip, turning with it.

scale.description: Grain size: 1 is the pattern's or image's own size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How much the grain takes out of each dab: 0 none, 1 only the peaks paint (default 0.6).

contrast.description: Height contrast around the middle: below 1 softer, above 1 harsher (default 1).

marks.description: How the tip is laid along the path (default continuous): continuous dabs, a scatter of spray droplets, particles, or objects (editable stickers).

oneOf.description: Dabs laid along the path (the default).
A spray (a spray can): each dab lays a seeded scatter of droplets across the tip; jitter and size come from dynamics and the tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

size.description: Droplet size as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.12).

oneOf.description: Particles that move with the pen and draw as they go. Missing fields take their defaults.

physics.description: How the particles move (default spring). string: strands dragged behind the pen (hair, fur); spring: on springs to the pen, overshooting; orbit: circling the pen (curls); flow: thrown into a swirling flow until they fade; elastic: links that stretch and snap back; fuzzy: winding strings waving out of step.

render.description: How they draw (default line). dot: a mark per step; line: a continuous line each; sequence: beads spaced along each path; ribbon: the band between neighbouring paths filled.

count.description: Particles (flow: thrown per tip of travel). Default 12.

size.description: Mark size as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its edge width (default 0.08).

spread.description: How far apart they start, as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its width (default 0.5).

stiffness.description: Spring, string and elastic stiffness: stiff follows closely, soft swings wide (default 0.4).

life.description: Flow particles: how long they live (default 0.5).

ribbonFill.description: Ribbon: fill opacity between the paths, relative to their edges (default 0.5; 0 only edges).

ribbonPairs.description: Ribbon: adjacent (default) joins each particle to its neighbour; first-last makes one band between the outermost two.

waveAmplitude.description: Wave: sideways swing as a fraction of the tip size (default 0: no wave).

waveLength.description: Wave: wavelength in px of pen travel (default 60).

wavePhaseJitter.description: Wave: how far out of step the particles' waves are; 0 in step, 1 random phases (default 0).

stampOrder.description: Stamp tips: sequence (default) uses the stamps in turn; random picks one per dot, seeded.

stampRotation.description: Stamp tips: follow turns each with its particle's motion; random (default); fixed uses the tip angle.

oneOf.description: Each mark stays an editable object (a sticker) on a sticker layer; needs a stamp tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

density.description: About density × 4 marks per tip diameter of travel; 0.25 ≈ one per diameter (default 0.4).

rotationJitter.description: Random turn as a fraction of ±180° (default 1).

scatter.description: How far from the path marks land, in tip diameters (default 0.5).

colourJitter.description: Random colour change: at 1 up to ±40° of hue and ±0.15 OKLab lightness (default 0.2).

dynamics.description: Pen feel: pressure, tilt, velocity, jitter, rotation and smoothing. Every amount 0 (off) .. 1 unless noted; missing fields take their defaults.

pressureSize.description: Pressure scales the size, down to minSize (default true).

pressureSmoothing.description: Pressure smoothing, separate from position smoothing (default 0).

rotation.description: What turns the tip: fixed (tip.angle, default), stroke (direction of travel) or barrel (pen barrel rotation).

minSize.description: Size at zero pressure as a fraction of the full size, with pressureSize (default 0).

tiltSize.description: Laying the pen down widens the tip, up to 2.5× (default 0).

tiltRoundness.description: Laying the pen down flattens the tip along the tilt, side-of-the-pencil shading (default 0).

tiltOpacity.description: Laying the pen down lightens the mark (default 0).

velocitySize.description: Positive grows the tip on fast strokes, negative thins it; needs timed points (default 0).

velocityOpacity.description: Positive darkens fast marks, negative lightens them; needs timed points (default 0).

angleJitter.description: Random angle per dab, as a fraction of ±180° (default 0).

scatter.description: Random offset across the stroke, in diameters (default 0).

count.description: Dabs laid at each spacing step, each with its own jitter and scatter (default 1). Dab brushes.

flip.description: Mirror each dab at random across x, y or both (default none): variety for image and stamp tips.

behaviour.description: What the material does on the surface, and how tools work. Missing fields take their defaults.

surface.description: dry (default): stays where it lands; wet: flows, pools and dries (see wet); thick: stands up in relief (see thick).

grain.description: Paper grain response: 0 ignores the grain, 1 catches only its peaks at light pressure (pencil, pastel, charcoal). Default 0.

mixing.description: How colours mix: pigment (Kubelka-Munk, blue and yellow make green) or rgb (straight averages). Default pigment; a Mixer Brush and the smudge tool default to rgb.

exchange.description: Paint exchange with the canvas: picking up paint and mixing it into what the brush lays. Paint brushes on a dry, wet or thick surface and Mixer Brushes.

pickup.description: Pick-up ratio: how much of the paint under each dab the brush lifts and carries (default 0; with a reservoir 0.5).

mix.description: Mix ratio: how much of the carried paint goes into what the brush lays, against its own colour (default 0.5).

dirty.description: Keep the carried paint after the stroke, so the next one starts with the last colour touched (default false).

reservoir.description: A paint reservoir makes this a Mixer Brush (an empty object takes every default).

load.description: How much paint the reservoir holds; below 1 it drains per dab and long strokes run dry (default 0.5).

refill.description: Refill with the paint colour before each stroke (default true).

loadsColour.description: Load the current colour at all (default true; false: it only moves paint already down).

wet.description: Wet surface (watercolour, gouache, wet oil) and the wet tools. Missing fields take their defaults.

medium.description: The wet medium; a layer takes the medium's wet settings the first time it holds wet paint (default: the variety when it is watercolor, gouache or oil, else watercolor).

water.description: Wetness: water laid, 0.2 a damp brush .. 1 dripping (default 0.5).

pigment.description: Pigment concentration: 0 clear water .. 1 straight from the tube (default 0.5).

rewet.description: How much dried paint the water lifts again: 0 staining (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the brush runs dry along a long stroke (default 1).

thinner.description: Thinner (water or solvent): more transparent, runnier paint (default 0).

thick.description: Thick surface (impasto: paint with relief, lit by the canvas lighting). Missing fields take their defaults.

applicator.description: What lays the paint (default brush). brush: bristle ridges; tube: blobs squeezed from the tube; knife: scrapes the relief flat and smears; roller: a flat stippled band; gloop: a thick glossy bead.

thickness.description: How far the paint stands up (default 0.6).

metallic.description: Metallic: highlights take the paint colour, gold, copper, silver (default 0).

drag.description: Knife and brush: how much of the paint under the tool is dragged along (default 0.4).

rim.description: Light paint: light is stronger where the bead turns away, as on backlit glass (default 0).

clarity.description: Glassy paint: the middle of a bead lets the layers below show through (default 0).

strength.description: Tools: how strongly the blender, smudge or wet tool works per dab (default 0.5; smudge 0.7).

distance.description: Blender: how far away colours are mixed in, as a fraction of the tip diameter (default 0.35).

length.description: Smudge: how far paint is dragged, the share of carried paint kept per dab (default 0.85).

light.description: Light the brush gives off with its colour (glow and spill). Give light brushes dark paper.

amount.description: Light per dab, scaled by its coverage and flow (default 0: none).

spill.description: Suggested spill for the layer, applied when it has none of its own.

radius.description: How far the light reaches, px; 0 turns spill off (a highlighter).

glow.description: Suggest a glow layer effect for the layer (glow stays a layer effect).

fluorescence.description: UV-fluorescent ink: glows in its colour under the virtual UV blacklight (set_uv_light); invisible in normal light when invisible is true.

amount.description: Fluorescence intensity under UV blacklight, 0 (none) .. 1.

invisible.description: Invisible ink in normal light: lays no daylight paint and glows only under UV (default false).

thermochromic.description: Thermochromic ink: shifts smoothly toward hotColor where the canvas heat field warms it past threshold.

hotColor.description: Colour (#rrggbb) the ink turns when heated.

threshold.description: Temperature 0.05..0.95 at which the colour shift is halfway (default 0.5).

iridescence.description: Structural colour: a thin dielectric film over the paint whose interference hue shifts with the light and view tilt. Missing fields take their defaults.

thickness.description: Film thickness in nanometres, 100..1000 (default 400).

pressureToThickness.description: How much pen pressure shifts the film thickness per dab, 0..1 (default 0: uniform thickness).

ior.description: Refractive index of the film, 1.2..2.0 (default 1.5; water/soap ~1.33, pearl ~1.55, beetle lacquer ~1.65).

ghost.description: Ghost paint: wet paint that flows and mixes visibly while wet, then fades away without leaving its colour, keeping only the smear it made in the paint it touched (needs behaviour.surface "wet").

linger.description: Seconds of simulated time before the ghost paint has fully faded (default 4).

smear.description: How much the ghost paint drags and lifts the paint it passes through: 0 none .. 1 full (default 0.3).

trigger.description: When the fade starts: immediate (default) counts down as soon as the paint is laid; agent holds the fade until read_mutation claims the stroke.

mutation.description: Mutation paint: you paint something and pause; once an agent claims it with read_mutation, your paint sinks away and the agent paints its own answer (any wet or dry paint brush that lays its own colour without reading paint beneath).

settle.description: Seconds after the last stroke before it counts as finished and raises a mutation request (default 1.5).

patience.description: Seconds to wait for an agent before giving up and keeping the paint as ordinary paint (default 45).

fade.description: Seconds the paint takes to sink away once claimed by read_mutation (default 2).

ferro.description: Liquid ferrofluid paint: 0..1 (amount), or { amount, wavelength, threshold }. Rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

anyOf.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (0..1).

tools.description: Lists the recorded strokes, oldest first (every stroke is kept as data): id, layer, brush id and name, colour, point count, bounds, seed and whether it is live. With ids, also the points. Use the ids with replay_strokes. With live true, lists the strokes of stroke layers as they are now, bottom first: the ones update_stroke, edit_stroke_points, reorder_stroke and remove_strokes change.

layerId.description: Only strokes of this layer.
