tools.name: update_stroke
tools.title: Change a stroke
tools.description: Changes a stroke on a stroke layer after it was painted: another brush preset (brushId, keeping the stroke size), brush settings (as set_brush takes), colour (replaces gradient paint), paint, or seed, then redraws the layer exactly. Ids come from list_strokes {live: true}. Refuses brushes a stroke layer cannot redraw (wet, impasto, sticker, eraser, smudge, blender, pick-up). One undo step. Returns the stroke and the area that changed.

brushId.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets; the stroke keeps its size.

description.description: What the brush is for, in a sentence.

items.description: A tag: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

kind.description: mark: lays a material (see medium); tool: works on paint already down (see tool).

medium.description: Marks: what it lays. paint (dry, wet or thick), ink, dry (pencil, pastel, charcoal) or spray (airbrush). Descriptive: the tip, marks and behaviour decide how it renders.

variety.description: What kind of the medium: oil, watercolor, gouache, pencil, pastel, charcoal, airbrush, marker, highlighter… A wet brush whose variety is watercolor, gouache or oil paints that medium.

tool.description: Tools: eraser removes paint; blender mixes the colours under the tip; smudge drags paint along; water lays clear water (lifts dried paint with behaviour.wet.rewet); dryer dries wet paint; blow pushes water along; blot takes wet paint up; wet-blend evens out wet pigment; wet-drag drags wet paint.

tip.description: The tip: its shape and the dab it lays. In a patch, shape may be left out to keep it.

shape.description: round, flat, chisel: an ellipse set by roundness and angle (the name is for people); bristle: a tuft of bristles (see bristle); stamp: dabs shaped like a stamp, a sticker or an image source (see stamps), also laid as sprays, objects or particles.

size.description: Diameter in px (default 20).

hardness.description: Edge hardness, 0 soft .. 1 hard (default 1). Image-source stamps fade towards their edges below 1.

spacing.description: Dab spacing as a fraction of the diameter: 0.05 smooth, 1 dotted (default 0.1).

angle.description: Tip angle in degrees, counter-clockwise; added to the stroke direction or barrel with dynamics.rotation (default 0).

roundness.description: Roundness: 1 round (default), lower a flat ellipse (pastel, chisel).

opacity.description: Stroke opacity ceiling: overlapping dabs never exceed it (default 1).

flow.description: Build-up per dab towards the opacity: low flow builds softly, like an airbrush (default 1).

blend.description: How the stroke paints onto the layer (default normal). pigment mixes like real paint; multiply darkens like marker ink; watercolor glazes; tint, highlight and shadow recolour, light and shade.

bristle.description: Bristle tips: the tuft. Missing fields take their defaults.

count.description: Bristles in the tuft (default 32).

stiffness.description: Stiff bristles follow the tip; soft ones lag and bend into curves at turns (default 0.5).

splay.description: How far pressure spreads the tuft (default 0.5).

thickness.description: Each bristle's line width as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.06).

load.description: Paint per bristle: 1 never runs dry; lower, bristles run out along the stroke, a dry brush (default 0.6).

jitter.description: Random variation between bristles: length, paint, position (default 0.4).

items.description: A sticker ref provider:id (find_stickers lists them; the editor's own are editor:dot, editor:star, editor:heart, editor:leaf, editor:flower, editor:confetti, editor:splat, editor:sparkle, editor:ring), or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources lists them; add_brush_source makes one from an image). A bare editor stamp (star) means editor:star.

stamps.description: Stamp tips: stickers or image sources (source:<id>). Continuous dabs and sprays lay the first; objects take only stickers and pick one at random per mark (default editor:star; repeats count once); particles use the first 4 in marks.stampOrder, and repeats weight the order.

grain.description: Texture inside the tip (a grain source), separate from the paper's grain: each dab is multiplied by it. Continuous and scatter marks of round and stamp tips.

source.description: The texture: a built-in pattern (cold-pressed, hot-pressed, rough, vellum, laid, ingres, sanded, canvas, linen, gesso) or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources); light parts are peaks, which paint.

mode.description: texturised (default): the grain stays put on the canvas, a texture under the paint; moving: it rolls along with the tip, turning with it.

scale.description: Grain size: 1 is the pattern's or image's own size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How much the grain takes out of each dab: 0 none, 1 only the peaks paint (default 0.6).

contrast.description: Height contrast around the middle: below 1 softer, above 1 harsher (default 1).

marks.description: How the tip is laid along the path (default continuous): continuous dabs, a scatter of spray droplets, particles, or objects (editable stickers).

oneOf.description: Dabs laid along the path (the default).
A spray (a spray can): each dab lays a seeded scatter of droplets across the tip; jitter and size come from dynamics and the tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

size.description: Droplet size as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.12).

oneOf.description: Particles that move with the pen and draw as they go. Missing fields take their defaults.

physics.description: How the particles move (default spring). string: strands dragged behind the pen (hair, fur); spring: on springs to the pen, overshooting; orbit: circling the pen (curls); flow: thrown into a swirling flow until they fade; elastic: links that stretch and snap back; fuzzy: winding strings waving out of step.

render.description: How they draw (default line). dot: a mark per step; line: a continuous line each; sequence: beads spaced along each path; ribbon: the band between neighbouring paths filled.

count.description: Particles (flow: thrown per tip of travel). Default 12.

size.description: Mark size as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its edge width (default 0.08).

spread.description: How far apart they start, as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its width (default 0.5).

stiffness.description: Spring, string and elastic stiffness: stiff follows closely, soft swings wide (default 0.4).

life.description: Flow particles: how long they live (default 0.5).

ribbonFill.description: Ribbon: fill opacity between the paths, relative to their edges (default 0.5; 0 only edges).

ribbonPairs.description: Ribbon: adjacent (default) joins each particle to its neighbour; first-last makes one band between the outermost two.

waveAmplitude.description: Wave: sideways swing as a fraction of the tip size (default 0: no wave).

waveLength.description: Wave: wavelength in px of pen travel (default 60).

wavePhaseJitter.description: Wave: how far out of step the particles' waves are; 0 in step, 1 random phases (default 0).

stampOrder.description: Stamp tips: sequence (default) uses the stamps in turn; random picks one per dot, seeded.

stampRotation.description: Stamp tips: follow turns each with its particle's motion; random (default); fixed uses the tip angle.

oneOf.description: Each mark stays an editable object (a sticker) on a sticker layer; needs a stamp tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

density.description: About density × 4 marks per tip diameter of travel; 0.25 ≈ one per diameter (default 0.4).

rotationJitter.description: Random turn as a fraction of ±180° (default 1).

scatter.description: How far from the path marks land, in tip diameters (default 0.5).

colourJitter.description: Random colour change: at 1 up to ±40° of hue and ±0.15 OKLab lightness (default 0.2).

dynamics.description: Pen feel: pressure, tilt, velocity, jitter, rotation and smoothing. Every amount 0 (off) .. 1 unless noted; missing fields take their defaults.

pressureSize.description: Pressure scales the size, down to minSize (default true).

pressureSmoothing.description: Pressure smoothing, separate from position smoothing (default 0).

rotation.description: What turns the tip: fixed (tip.angle, default), stroke (direction of travel) or barrel (pen barrel rotation).

minSize.description: Size at zero pressure as a fraction of the full size, with pressureSize (default 0).

tiltSize.description: Laying the pen down widens the tip, up to 2.5× (default 0).

tiltRoundness.description: Laying the pen down flattens the tip along the tilt, side-of-the-pencil shading (default 0).

tiltOpacity.description: Laying the pen down lightens the mark (default 0).

velocitySize.description: Positive grows the tip on fast strokes, negative thins it; needs timed points (default 0).

velocityOpacity.description: Positive darkens fast marks, negative lightens them; needs timed points (default 0).

angleJitter.description: Random angle per dab, as a fraction of ±180° (default 0).

scatter.description: Random offset across the stroke, in diameters (default 0).

count.description: Dabs laid at each spacing step, each with its own jitter and scatter (default 1). Dab brushes.

flip.description: Mirror each dab at random across x, y or both (default none): variety for image and stamp tips.

behaviour.description: What the material does on the surface, and how tools work. Missing fields take their defaults.

surface.description: dry (default): stays where it lands; wet: flows, pools and dries (see wet); thick: stands up in relief (see thick).

grain.description: Paper grain response: 0 ignores the grain, 1 catches only its peaks at light pressure (pencil, pastel, charcoal). Default 0.

mixing.description: How colours mix: pigment (Kubelka-Munk, blue and yellow make green) or rgb (straight averages). Default pigment; a Mixer Brush and the smudge tool default to rgb.

exchange.description: Paint exchange with the canvas: picking up paint and mixing it into what the brush lays. Paint brushes on a dry, wet or thick surface and Mixer Brushes.

pickup.description: Pick-up ratio: how much of the paint under each dab the brush lifts and carries (default 0; with a reservoir 0.5).

mix.description: Mix ratio: how much of the carried paint goes into what the brush lays, against its own colour (default 0.5).

dirty.description: Keep the carried paint after the stroke, so the next one starts with the last colour touched (default false).

reservoir.description: A paint reservoir makes this a Mixer Brush (an empty object takes every default).

load.description: How much paint the reservoir holds; below 1 it drains per dab and long strokes run dry (default 0.5).

refill.description: Refill with the paint colour before each stroke (default true).

loadsColour.description: Load the current colour at all (default true; false: it only moves paint already down).

wet.description: Wet surface (watercolour, gouache, wet oil) and the wet tools. Missing fields take their defaults.

medium.description: The wet medium; a layer takes the medium's wet settings the first time it holds wet paint (default: the variety when it is watercolor, gouache or oil, else watercolor).

water.description: Wetness: water laid, 0.2 a damp brush .. 1 dripping (default 0.5).

pigment.description: Pigment concentration: 0 clear water .. 1 straight from the tube (default 0.5).

rewet.description: How much dried paint the water lifts again: 0 staining (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the brush runs dry along a long stroke (default 1).

thinner.description: Thinner (water or solvent): more transparent, runnier paint (default 0).

thick.description: Thick surface (impasto: paint with relief, lit by the canvas lighting). Missing fields take their defaults.

applicator.description: What lays the paint (default brush). brush: bristle ridges; tube: blobs squeezed from the tube; knife: scrapes the relief flat and smears; roller: a flat stippled band; gloop: a thick glossy bead.

thickness.description: How far the paint stands up (default 0.6).

metallic.description: Metallic: highlights take the paint colour, gold, copper, silver (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the stroke thins as the brush empties (default 0.9).

drag.description: Knife and brush: how much of the paint under the tool is dragged along (default 0.4).

rim.description: Light paint: light is stronger where the bead turns away, as on backlit glass (default 0).

clarity.description: Glassy paint: the middle of a bead lets the layers below show through (default 0).

strength.description: Tools: how strongly the blender, smudge or wet tool works per dab (default 0.5; smudge 0.7).

distance.description: Blender: how far away colours are mixed in, as a fraction of the tip diameter (default 0.35).

length.description: Smudge: how far paint is dragged, the share of carried paint kept per dab (default 0.85).

light.description: Light the brush gives off with its colour (glow and spill). Give light brushes dark paper.

amount.description: Light per dab, scaled by its coverage and flow (default 0: none).

spill.description: Suggested spill for the layer, applied when it has none of its own.

radius.description: How far the light reaches, px; 0 turns spill off (a highlighter).

glow.description: Suggest a glow layer effect for the layer (glow stays a layer effect).

fluorescence.description: UV-fluorescent ink: glows in its colour under the virtual UV blacklight (set_uv_light); invisible in normal light when invisible is true.

amount.description: Fluorescence intensity under UV blacklight, 0 (none) .. 1.

invisible.description: Invisible ink in normal light: lays no daylight paint and glows only under UV (default false).

thermochromic.description: Thermochromic ink: shifts smoothly toward hotColor where the canvas heat field warms it past threshold.

hotColor.description: Colour (#rrggbb) the ink turns when heated.

threshold.description: Temperature 0.05..0.95 at which the colour shift is halfway (default 0.5).

iridescence.description: Structural colour: a thin dielectric film over the paint whose interference hue shifts with the light and view tilt. Missing fields take their defaults.

thickness.description: Film thickness in nanometres, 100..1000 (default 400).

pressureToThickness.description: How much pen pressure shifts the film thickness per dab, 0..1 (default 0: uniform thickness).

ior.description: Refractive index of the film, 1.2..2.0 (default 1.5; water/soap ~1.33, pearl ~1.55, beetle lacquer ~1.65).

ghost.description: Ghost paint: wet paint that flows and mixes visibly while wet, then fades away without leaving its colour, keeping only the smear it made in the paint it touched (needs behaviour.surface "wet").

linger.description: Seconds of simulated time before the ghost paint has fully faded (default 4).

smear.description: How much the ghost paint drags and lifts the paint it passes through: 0 none .. 1 full (default 0.3).

trigger.description: When the fade starts: immediate (default) counts down as soon as the paint is laid; agent holds the fade until read_mutation claims the stroke.

mutation.description: Mutation paint: you paint something and pause; once an agent claims it with read_mutation, your paint sinks away and the agent paints its own answer (any wet or dry paint brush that lays its own colour without reading paint beneath).

settle.description: Seconds after the last stroke before it counts as finished and raises a mutation request (default 1.5).

patience.description: Seconds to wait for an agent before giving up and keeping the paint as ordinary paint (default 45).

fade.description: Seconds the paint takes to sink away once claimed by read_mutation (default 2).

ferro.description: Liquid ferrofluid paint: 0..1 (amount), or { amount, wavelength, threshold }. Rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

fps.description: Suggested playback rate in frames per second.

secondColor.description: Optional second colour (#rrggbb) that V blends the wet paint towards; null or omitted modulates pigment density/contrast.

relief.description: Impasto relief height written to the layer thick map as patterns grow (0..1, default 0).

Gradient paint: the brush samples it dab by dab as the stroke goes. Example (blue to yellow over 300 px of stroke, and back): { "type": "gradient", "stops": [{ "offset": 0, "color": "#1d4ed8" }, { "offset": 1, "color": "#facc15" }], "map": { "by": "distance", "length": 300, "repeat": "mirror" } }.

offset.description: Where the stop is, 0..1 along the gradient. Stops must be sorted by offset.

color.description: #rrggbb, or "paint" / "secondary": the editor's paint or second colour when the stroke starts.

opacity.description: 0..1 (default 1): multiplies the brush's flow where this colour is laid.

midpoint.description: Where between this stop and the next the colours are half mixed, 0.05..0.95 of the way (default 0.5).

space.description: How neighbouring stops mix: pigment (default; like paint, blue to yellow passes green), oklab (perceptual) or srgb (plain numbers).

map.description: What moves the stroke along the gradient (default distance, 300 px, mirror).

by.description: distance: px (or dabs) of stroke travelled; pressure: pen pressure 0..1; tilt: pen lean, upright 0 .. flat 1; velocity: pen speed, 0 .. 2.5 px/ms; direction: direction of travel, once round per 360°; time: ms since the stroke began (needs timed points); across-tip: left to right across the tip, looking along the stroke (a brush loaded with several colours); random: a random point per dab (seeded, so replays match).

length.description: distance: px of travel (or dabs, with unit "dabs") per run through the gradient (default 300).

repeat.description: distance and time: past the end, clamp (hold the last colour), repeat (start again) or mirror (run back; default for distance, clamp for time).

duration.description: time: ms per run through the gradient (default 2000).

softness.description: How softly neighbouring stops blend: 1 smooth (default) .. 0 hard steps.

anyOf.description: Back to the stroke’s plain colour.

paint.description: A colour or gradient paint for the stroke; null drops its gradient.

seed.description: Another jitter seed: particles, scatter and texture fall differently.

tools.name: edit_stroke_points
tools.title: Move or reshape a stroke
tools.description: Replaces a stroke’s points (points, document pixels), or moves, scales, rotates or flips it (transform, about its centre unless origin is given; the brush size scales with it), then redraws its stroke layer exactly. Pass one of points or transform. One undo step. Returns the stroke with its points and the area that changed.

points.description: The path in document pixels (raw samples; the brush smooths them). One point paints one dab.

t.description: Time in milliseconds (optional; drives velocity dynamics, e.g. an ink pen thinning on fast strokes).

tiltX.description: Pen tilt in degrees towards +x (Pointer Events tiltX).

tiltY.description: Pen tilt in degrees towards +y (Pointer Events tiltY).

altitude.description: Pen altitude in radians: 1.5708 upright, 0 lying flat (overrides tiltX / tiltY).

azimuth.description: Where the pen leans, radians clockwise from +x (with altitude).

twist.description: Barrel rotation in degrees (brushes with rotation barrel).

transform.description: A move, scale, rotation or flip of the whole stroke.

dx.description: Move right by this many pixels (default 0).

dy.description: Move down by this many pixels (default 0).

scale.description: Scale about the origin; brush size scales too (default 1).

rotate.description: Rotate about the origin, degrees clockwise (default 0).

flipX.description: Mirror left to right about the origin (default false).

origin.description: Centre for scale, rotate and flip (default the centre of the stroke).

tools.name: reorder_stroke
tools.title: Move a stroke up or down
tools.description: Moves a stroke to index in its stroke layer (0 = bottom, drawn first) and redraws the layer. One undo step. Returns the new order of ids, bottom first.

annotations.title: Move a stroke up or down

tools.name: remove_strokes
tools.title: Delete strokes
tools.description: Deletes strokes from their stroke layers (the eraser of a stroke layer) and redraws them. All checked first; one undo step. Returns the ids removed and the area that changed.

tools.name: convert_to_stroke_layer
tools.title: Make a layer a stroke layer
tools.description: Makes an empty pixel layer a stroke layer, so strokes painted on it stay editable. Refuses a layer with paint (add_layer {type: "strokes"} instead). One undo step. Returns the layer.

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

annotations.title: Make a layer a stroke layer

tools.name: rasterize_stroke_layer
tools.title: Rasterize a stroke layer
tools.description: Turns a stroke layer into a plain pixel layer with the same pixels: its strokes stop being editable, and erasers, smudges and fills work on it. One undo step. Returns the layer.

layerId.description: Stroke layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: replay_strokes
tools.title: Replay strokes, varied
tools.description: Paints recorded strokes again, moved, scaled, rotated, flipped, recoloured, with another brush or on another layer, repeat times (each repeat applies the variation again: a row, a fan, a spiral). Strokes replay exactly (same seed). All of it is one undo step. Returns the new stroke ids, the changed bounds and layer ids.

dx.description: Move right by this many pixels per repeat (default 0).

dy.description: Move down by this many pixels per repeat (default 0).

scale.description: Scale per repeat about the origin; brush size scales too (default 1).

rotate.description: Rotate per repeat about the origin, degrees clockwise (default 0).

flipX.description: Mirror left to right about the origin (default false).

origin.description: Centre for scale, rotate and flip (default the centre of the strokes).

brushId.description: Replay with this brush from list_brush_presets (default each stroke’s brush).

layerId.description: Paint on this layer (default each stroke’s layer).

repeat.description: How many copies (default 1).

tools.name: set_view
tools.title: Rotate, mirror or zoom the view
tools.description: Changes the view only (the pixels never resample): zoom, rotation and mirroring, as an artist turns the paper or checks the drawing in a mirror. Editor state, not an undo step. Returns the view.

reset.description: Back to 100 %, no rotation, no mirror, centred (applied first).

annotations.title: Rotate, mirror or zoom the view

tools.name: set_hand
tools.title: Set the drawing hand
tools.description: Says which hand holds the pen; palm rejection ignores touches on that side of the pen. Editor state, not an undo step. Returns the hand.

tools.name: undo_paint
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the last step (a stroke, a fill, a layer or paper change). Returns the label undone (null when there was nothing) and what can be undone and redone next.

tools.name: redo_paint
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes the last undone step. Returns the label redone (null when there was nothing) and what can be undone and redone next.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.title: Render a preview
tools.description: Renders the painting (with its paper unless paper is false) or some layers as a PNG whose longest side is at most maxSide. Changes nothing. Look at it after each block of work.

tools.name: export_image
tools.title: Export the painting
tools.description: Exports the painting as PNG, JPEG or WebP (base64). JPEG always includes the paper; JPEG and WebP need a browser canvas. With time, live effect paint is drawn at that moment (get_effect_playback / set_effect_playback). Changes nothing. Returns the data, its MIME type and size.

scale.description: Shrink by this factor (default 1).

time.description: Draw live effect paint (strokes on stroke layers painted with live effect paint) this many ms into its animation (default: as painted, its own time).

tools.name: export_psd
tools.title: Export as PSD
tools.description: Writes the painting as an 8-bit RGB PSD (PSB above 30000 px) through the shared PSD writer: every layer and group with its opacity, blend, mask and locks, the paper as a locked "Paper" pixel layer at the bottom, and the composite as the merged image. Changes nothing. Returns the file as base64, its size, whether it is a PSB, and warnings (pigment and painterly blend modes have no PSD equivalent: they are written as the nearest standard mode, see list_blend_modes).

time.description: Draw live effect paint (strokes on stroke layers painted with live effect paint) this many ms into its animation (default: as painted, its own time).

tools.name: get_guides
tools.title: Get the painting guides
tools.description: Reads the painting guides: symmetry (mode, centre, rotation, segments, mirror, and how many copies each stroke paints), the perspective guide (vanishing points, snap), the tracing image (size, placement, opacity, visibility, colour sampling), the reference images and the stencils (id, kind, mode, geometry).

tools.name: set_symmetry
tools.title: Set mirror or kaleidoscope painting
tools.description: Turns symmetry on or off. Every stroke after it also paints its copies, as one stroke and one undo step: vertical, horizontal or diagonal mirror (one copy), dual (four-way), or kaleidoscope with n segments (rotated copies, and with mirror the reflections between them). Editor state, saved with the document. Returns the guide and the number of copies.

mode.description: off, vertical (mirror left / right), horizontal (top / bottom), dual, diagonal or kaleidoscope.

center.description: Centre of the axes in document pixels (default the canvas centre).

mirror.description: Kaleidoscope: also reflect alternate segments (default true).

tools.name: set_perspective_guide
tools.title: Set the perspective guide
tools.description: Sets one to three vanishing points (document pixels, may be off the canvas). With snap on, pen strokes snap to the line through their start towards a vanishing point (one-point also keeps horizontals and verticals, two-point verticals); for paint_stroke pass snapToPerspective. Editor state, saved with the document. Returns the guide.

snap.description: Snap strokes to the guide lines (default true).

tools.name: set_tracing_image
tools.title: Set a tracing image
tools.description: Puts an image under the paint to trace over (view only: never exported), fitted to the canvas unless rect is given, at opacity (default 0.35). With sampleColors, strokes without a colour take the image colour where they start, so painting over it copies its colours. Replaces any tracing image. Returns its size and placement.

png.description: The image as a PNG, base64 or a data:image/png URL.

opacity.description: Opacity 0..1 (default 0.35).

sampleColors.description: Strokes take their colour from the image (default false).

tools.name: update_tracing_image
tools.title: Change the tracing image
tools.description: Changes the tracing image opacity, visibility, placement or colour sampling. Returns it.

opacity.description: Opacity 0..1.

sampleColors.description: Strokes take their colour from it.

tools.name: clear_tracing_image
tools.title: Remove the tracing image
tools.description: Removes the tracing image. Returns null.

tools.name: add_reference_image
tools.title: Add a reference image
tools.description: Adds a floating reference image (shown beside the canvas, never painted) to look at and pick colours from with pick_reference_color. Returns its id, size and placement.

png.description: The image as a PNG, base64 or a data:image/png URL.

displayWidth.description: Panel width in screen pixels (default up to 240).

tools.name: list_reference_images
tools.title: List reference images
tools.description: Lists the reference images: id, name, size in pixels, panel placement and visibility.

tools.name: update_reference_image
tools.title: Change a reference image
tools.description: Moves, resizes, renames, shows or hides a reference image panel. Returns it.

tools.name: remove_reference_image
tools.title: Remove a reference image
tools.description: Removes a reference image. Returns the removed id.

tools.name: pick_reference_color
tools.title: Pick a colour from a reference
tools.description: Reads the colour of a reference image at its own pixel (x, y). With setColor it becomes the paint colour. Returns #rrggbb.

setColor.description: Also make it the paint colour (default false).

annotations.title: Pick a colour from a reference

tools.name: color_harmony
tools.title: Colour harmonies
tools.description: Returns the colours of a harmony around a colour (default the paint colour): complementary, split-complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, square or monochromatic, on the painter’s red-yellow-blue wheel (default: red’s complement is green) or the RGB wheel. Changes nothing. Returns the colours with their wheel angles, the base first.

spread.description: Analogous and split-complementary spread in degrees (default 30).

tools.name: list_swatches
tools.title: List swatches
tools.description: Lists the swatches (index, colour, name, and paint for a gradient swatch).

tools.name: add_swatch
tools.title: Add a swatch
tools.description: Adds a swatch (saved with the document): a colour, or with paint a gradient (set_paint picks it up again from list_swatches). Give color or paint. Returns the swatches; a gradient swatch has paint and its first colour as color.

paint.description: Gradient paint (or a colour) for the swatch, instead of color.

tools.name: remove_swatch
tools.title: Remove a swatch
tools.description: Removes a swatch by index (from list_swatches). Returns the swatches.

tools.name: mixing_pad_stroke
tools.title: Paint on the mixing pad
tools.description: Paints on the mixing pad (a 360 × 220 scratch canvas, not the painting): tool paint lays down a colour with a pigment Mixer Brush; tool knife smears what is there like a palette knife, mixing it as paint. Points are pad pixels. Not an undo step. Returns the changed bounds; then pick_mixing_pad_color. For a measured mix in one call use mix_on_pad.

color.description: Paint colour (default the paint colour; ignored by the knife).

size.description: Tool size in pad pixels (default 28 paint, 34 knife).

tools.name: pick_mixing_pad_color
tools.title: Pick from the mixing pad
tools.description: Reads the mixed colour on the pad at (x, y), averaged over radius pixels (default 3); with setColor it becomes the paint colour. Returns #rrggbb, or null where the pad is bare.

setColor.description: Also make it the paint colour (default false).

tools.name: clear_mixing_pad
tools.title: Clear the mixing pad
tools.description: Wipes the mixing pad clean.

tools.name: mix_on_pad
tools.title: Mix paints on the pad
tools.description: Mixes paints on the mixing pad as a painter would: blobs whose areas follow their parts, worked with the palette knife, and a fully mixed core of the Kubelka-Munk (pigment) mix, so blue and yellow make green and white tints. One call per mix. Not an undo step (the pad is scratch space). Returns the mixed colour #rrggbb and the pile bounds in pad pixels; with setColor it becomes the paint colour. pick_mixing_pad_color reads the streaks around it.

parts.description: Parts of this paint, any scale (1 and 3 for a 1:3 mix); at least one above 0.

x.description: Centre of the pile, pad x (default 180).

y.description: Centre of the pile, pad y (default 110).

radius.description: Radius of the pile in pad pixels (default 40); it must fit on the pad.

passes.description: Palette-knife passes (default 3; more gives finer streaks around the core).

clear.description: Wipe the pile's area first (default true); false mixes into the paint already there.

setColor.description: Also make the mix the paint colour (default false).

tools.name: save_mixing_pad
tools.title: Keep the mixing pad
tools.description: Keeps the mixing pad as it is now under a name, saved with the document, to come back to with load_mixing_pad. Refused while the pad is empty. Returns the kept pad id and name.

tools.name: list_mixing_pads
tools.title: List kept mixing pads
tools.description: Lists the mixing pads kept with save_mixing_pad (id, name). Changes nothing.

tools.name: load_mixing_pad
tools.title: Load a kept mixing pad
tools.description: Puts a kept pad (id from list_mixing_pads) back on the mixing pad, replacing what is on it. Returns the pad id and name.

tools.name: remove_mixing_pad
tools.title: Remove a kept mixing pad
tools.description: Forgets a kept pad (id from list_mixing_pads); the pad on screen is untouched. Returns the removed id and name.

tools.name: render_mixing_pad
tools.title: Render the mixing pad
tools.description: Renders the mixing pad as a PNG (360 × 220, over white). Changes nothing.

tools.name: add_stencil
tools.title: Lay a stencil
tools.description: Lays a stencil on the canvas: a ruler (straight edge to draw along) or an arc (circle or part of one) that pointer and agent strokes starting near it follow exactly, or a line (straight masking edge) or a shape (rect, ellipse or polygon template) that paint lands only inside of (outside with invert). Editor state saved with the document, not an undo step; replays keep the mask they were painted through. Returns the stencil with its id.

mode.description: guide: strokes that start within snap px of the edge follow it; mask: paint lands only inside (or on the left of a line going from → to), outside with invert. Default guide for ruler and arc, mask for line and shape.

from.description: ruler / line: a point on the edge.

to.description: ruler / line: another point on the edge (the edge runs on past both).

startAngle.description: arc: where it starts, degrees clockwise from +x (default 0).

endAngle.description: arc: where it ends (default 360: the whole circle).

shape.description: shape: rect or ellipse (with rect) or polygon (with points).

rect.description: shape rect / ellipse: its bounds in document pixels.

points.description: shape polygon: its corners in order.

invert.description: mask: paint outside the shape (or on the right of the line) instead (default false).

snap.description: guide: how near the edge a stroke must start to follow it, px (default 40).

feather.description: mask: soft edge width in pixels (default 1).

tools.name: update_stencil
tools.title: Change a stencil
tools.description: Moves, reshapes, switches (guide or mask, invert) or hides (enabled false) a stencil by id from get_guides. Returns the stencil.

mode.description: guide: strokes that start within snap px of the edge follow it; mask: paint lands only inside (or on the left of a line going from → to), outside with invert. Default guide for ruler and arc, mask for line and shape.

from.description: ruler / line: a point on the edge.

to.description: ruler / line: another point on the edge (the edge runs on past both).

startAngle.description: arc: where it starts, degrees clockwise from +x (default 0).

endAngle.description: arc: where it ends (default 360: the whole circle).

shape.description: shape: rect or ellipse (with rect) or polygon (with points).

rect.description: shape rect / ellipse: its bounds in document pixels.

points.description: shape polygon: its corners in order.

invert.description: mask: paint outside the shape (or on the right of the line) instead (default false).

snap.description: guide: how near the edge a stroke must start to follow it, px (default 40).

feather.description: mask: soft edge width in pixels (default 1).

tools.name: remove_stencils
tools.title: Take stencils away
tools.description: Removes stencils by id, or every stencil when ids is missing. Returns the ids removed.

tools.name: get_wet_paint
tools.title: Get the wet paint
tools.description: Reads the wet media: whether any paint is still wet, the simulation clock (steps), whether time is paused, its speed (steps per second), the canvas tilt, the kernel running it (typescript, wasm, wasm-threads with the thread count, and a message when it runs slower than it could, e.g. without cross-origin isolation), and each wet layer: wet cells, where the water is (wetBounds), live tiles, its settings, flow map, and ghost: { remaining } (seconds of simulated time left when ghost paint is fading on the layer). Also engine: Engine B, the GPU accelerator: WebGPU in browsers, Metal in the Swift editors (mode auto/off, state, reason, adapter, minTiles, activeTiles). Call it after wet strokes to see what is still wet.

tools.name: advance_wet_paint
tools.title: Let the wet paint flow
tools.description: Lets time pass for wet paint: the water spreads, runs downhill on a tilted canvas, granulates, blooms and evaporates, and pigment settles. Give steps (simulation steps; at the default 120 per second, 120 steps is one second) or seconds (default 1). Not an undo step, as time passing never is. Returns the steps run, the clock, stillWet and each wet layer’s state. Paint dries by itself after a few thousand steps; dry_paint dries it at once. Wet light paint (wet brushes with light.amount) flows with the pigment and settles where it dries into the layer’s light (get_light).

steps.description: Simulation steps to run (default: seconds × speed).

seconds.description: Seconds of simulated time at the current speed (default 1; ignored when steps is given).

tools.name: dry_paint
tools.title: Dry the wet paint
tools.description: Dries wet paint at once: everything settles where it is and the water goes, as a hair dryer at full blast would (the same deterministic bake that saving uses). On one layer or every wet layer, optionally only inside rect. Dried washes stay put: later washes glaze over them instead of mixing in. One undo step. Returns dried (each layer id with the rectangle that dried) and stillWet.

layerId.description: Only this layer (default every wet layer).

tools.name: wet_paper
tools.title: Pre-wet the paper
tools.description: Wets the paper with clear water over rect (default the whole canvas) on a layer, for wet-in-wet: paint laid on damp paper spreads softly with feathered edges instead of stopping at a hard edge. One undo step. Returns the layer id, the rectangle and wet: true. The paper dries again over time (advance_wet_paint) or at once (dry_paint).

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

amount.description: How wet, 0..1 (default 1: soaked).

tools.name: set_wet_settings
tools.title: Set a layer’s wet settings
tools.description: Changes how wet paint behaves on a layer: viscosity, evaporation, edge darkening, pigment weight, granulation, pickup (re-wetting), fixture (staining), blooms and colour bleed, each 0..1. Missing fields keep their values. Applies to the paint already wet too. Saved with the document, not an undo step. Returns the settings and stillWet.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

viscosity.description: How thick the water is: 0 runny like ink .. 1 very thick (default 0.3, watercolour).

evaporation.description: How fast it dries: 0 never .. 1 very fast (default 0.45).

edgeDarkening.description: Darker rims where a wash dries (default 0.5).

pigmentWeight.description: Heavy pigment travels less and settles sooner (default 0.3).

granulation.description: Pigment collecting in the paper’s valleys, a grainy look (default 0.4; needs a rough paper).

pickup.description: How readily water lifts settled pigment again (default 0.2).

fixture.description: How fast pigment settles into the paper while wet, i.e. staining (default 0.2).

bloom.description: Blooms: water running into a drying wash pushes its pigment into cauliflower edges (default 0.4).

bleed.description: Colour bleed between touching wet areas (default 0.3).

tools.name: set_flow_map
tools.title: Set a flow map
tools.description: Pushes a layer’s water in a pattern while it is wet: linear (one direction, angle), swirl (around center, clockwise or not), radial (out from center) or turbulent (eddies of scale pixels, seeded), at strength 0..1; none turns it off. Saved with the document, not an undo step. Returns the flow map and stillWet.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

kind.description: none, linear, swirl, radial or turbulent.

strength.description: How hard it pushes, 0..1 (1 is about a 25° tilt; default 0.5).

angle.description: linear: direction in degrees clockwise from canvas down (default 0).

center.description: swirl / radial: centre in document pixels (default the canvas centre).

scale.description: turbulent: eddy size in pixels (default 120).

tools.name: set_canvas_tilt
tools.title: Tilt the canvas
tools.description: Tilts the canvas so wet paint runs downhill: angle 0 (flat) .. 90 (upright) degrees, direction the way down in degrees clockwise from the canvas bottom (0 runs towards the bottom edge, 90 towards the left). Steep tilts with very wet paint make drips. Saved with the document, not an undo step. Returns the tilt and stillWet.

direction.description: Downhill direction, degrees clockwise from canvas down (default unchanged).

tools.name: pause_wet_paint
tools.title: Pause or resume wet paint
tools.description: Stops time for wet paint (it stays wet and still) or lets it run again, and optionally sets the speed in steps per second. Editor state, not an undo step. Returns paused, speed and stillWet.

paused.description: true stops time, false resumes it.

speed.description: Steps per second while running (default unchanged; 120 at start).

tools.name: set_wet_engine
tools.title: Choose the wet-media engine
tools.description: Lets Engine B, the GPU accelerator (WebGPU in browsers, Metal in the Swift editors), run for large wet areas (gpu "auto", the default) or forces the CPU (gpu "off"), and optionally sets minTiles, the wet area at which the GPU takes over. The GPU only shades what is shown: the CPU engine stays the authority, so the painting, drying, saving, export and replay come out the same either way; force the CPU when the display looks wrong or the GPU is busy with other work. Editor setting, not an undo step, not saved with the painting. Returns the engine: mode, state (off, not-started, starting, unavailable, standby, active, failed), reason, adapter, maxTiles, minTiles and activeTiles.

gpu.description: "auto": use the GPU when there is one and the wet area is large; "off": the CPU only.

minTiles.description: Live 256 px tiles (all wet layers) at which the GPU takes over (default unchanged; 16 at start, a fully wet 1024² canvas).

tools.name: set_water_overlay
tools.title: Show the water
tools.description: Shows or hides the water overlay on the canvas (blue where the surface is wet, fainter where the paper is damp). View only, never in exports. Returns visible and stillWet.

tools.name: get_live_patterns
tools.title: Get live patterns
tools.description: Reads the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion live patterns on a layer (layerId, default the active layer): whether live patterns are enabled, the active settings (pattern, feed, kill, scale, contrast, secondColor, relief), activeTiles, patternCells, wetPatternCells (pattern cells still holding water where the pattern can grow), meanV, maxV, bounds, wet coverage (wet, wetCells, wetBounds), layers (every layer with wet paint or live patterns), and presets (built-in Pearson feed/kill presets: spots, stripes, coral, maze, worms). Call it before or after advance_wet_paint and dry_paint to inspect pattern growth and freezing.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: set_live_patterns
tools.title: Set live patterns
tools.description: Configures a layer’s Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion live patterns (or clears them with enabled: false). Patterns grow inside wet paint during advance_wet_paint and freeze when the paint dries (dry_paint). Choose a Pearson preset (spots, stripes, coral, maze, worms) or explicit feed and kill rates, scale, contrast, secondColor (#rrggbb or null to modulate pigment contrast) and relief (0..1, writes ridge height into thick paint so lighting catches the pattern). One undo step. Returns the layer’s live-pattern stats and stillWet.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

enabled.description: true (default) configures live patterns on the layer; false clears them.

pattern.description: Pearson Gray-Scott preset: spots, stripes, coral, maze or worms (default spots). Sets feed and kill unless explicit feed/kill are also passed.

feed.description: Gray-Scott feed rate F, 0.005..0.1 (default: the pattern preset’s feed rate).

kill.description: Gray-Scott kill rate k, 0.02..0.08 (default: the pattern preset’s kill rate).

scale.description: Diffusion scale 0.25..4 (larger values grow broader pattern features; default 1).

contrast.description: How strongly V modulates the wet pigment or blends toward secondColor, 0..2 (default 0.85).

secondColor.description: Optional #rrggbb colour that high-V pattern ridges blend toward, or null to modulate pigment contrast (default null).

relief.description: Impasto ridge height 0..1 written from V into the layer’s thick height map so light catches the pattern (default 0).

tools.name: seed_live_patterns
tools.title: Seed live patterns
tools.description: Seeds Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion activator (V) discs at points on a layer so reaction-diffusion patterns (spots, stripes, coral, maze, worms) grow where the layer holds wet water (advance_wet_paint) and freeze where it dries (dry_paint). Painting with a wet brush that has a livePatterns facet (such as preset "turing-wash" or "coral-ink") also seeds along the stroke automatically. One undo step. Returns seededCells, the layer’s live-pattern stats (patternCells, wetPatternCells, meanV, maxV, bounds) and stillWet.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

points.description: Seed centres in document pixels where reaction-diffusion activator V is nucleated.

radius.description: Seed disc radius in document pixels (default 16).

seed.description: Deterministic noise seed for the nucleated discs (default: next editor seed).

pattern.description: Pearson Gray-Scott preset: spots, stripes, coral, maze or worms (default spots). Sets feed and kill unless explicit feed/kill are also passed.

feed.description: Gray-Scott feed rate F, 0.005..0.1 (default: the pattern preset’s feed rate).

kill.description: Gray-Scott kill rate k, 0.02..0.08 (default: the pattern preset’s kill rate).

scale.description: Diffusion scale 0.25..4 (larger values grow broader pattern features; default 1).

contrast.description: How strongly V modulates the wet pigment or blends toward secondColor, 0..2 (default 0.85).

secondColor.description: Optional #rrggbb colour that high-V pattern ridges blend toward, or null to modulate pigment contrast (default null).

relief.description: Impasto ridge height 0..1 written from V into the layer’s thick height map so light catches the pattern (default 0).

tools.name: get_light
tools.title: Read a layer’s light paint
tools.description: Reads a layer’s light paint (laid by brushes with light.amount above 0): whether it has any, where it is (bounds, document pixels), its brightest value (peak 0..255) and its spill (radius px, strength). Changes nothing.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: set_light_spill
tools.title: Set how far a layer’s light spills
tools.description: Sets how far a layer’s light paint spills onto the paint and paper around it, in each stroke’s own colour: radius (px, 0 turns spill off, default 24) and strength (0..2, default 1). Nothing is repainted; saved with the document, not an undo step. Returns the layer’s spill.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

radius.description: How far the light reaches, px (0 turns spill off; default 24).

annotations.title: Set how far a layer’s light spills

tools.name: clear_light
tools.title: Clear a layer’s light
tools.description: Takes a layer’s light paint away; its paint keeps its colour (and relief). One undo step. Returns whether anything was cleared.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: set_lighting
tools.title: Move the light
tools.description: Sets where the light comes from for thick paint (impasto relief), thin-film iridescence and metallic paper: azimuth (degrees clockwise from the top of the canvas; 315 is top left), elevation (5 grazing, deep shadows .. 90 straight on, no relief) and relief (0 flat .. 1 strong). Nothing is repainted: the relief and iridescence are lit at render time. Saved with the document, not an undo step. Returns the lighting.

azimuth.description: Light direction in degrees clockwise from the top of the canvas (default 315).

elevation.description: Light height above the canvas in degrees (default 40).

tools.name: set_view_tilt
tools.title: Tilt the view angle for iridescence
tools.description: Tilts the viewer’s look angle for thin-film iridescence and specular highlights: x (-1 left .. 1 right, default 0) and y (-1 top .. 1 bottom, default 0). Moves the view vector, not the light, so iridescent paint (brushes with iridescence, such as scarab-lacquer, soap-film, pearl-glaze) shifts hue across the spectrum as the angle changes. Editor state (not saved with the document, not an undo step). Returns the view tilt.

annotations.title: Tilt the view angle for iridescence

tools.name: get_view_tilt
tools.title: Read the view tilt
tools.description: Reads the viewer’s look angle for thin-film iridescence and specular highlights: x and y in -1..1 (0, 0 is straight on). Changes nothing.

tools.name: get_relief
tools.title: Read a layer’s relief
tools.description: Reads a layer’s thick paint: where the relief is (bounds, layer pixels), its highest point (0..255) and the lighting. relief is null when the layer is flat. Changes nothing.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: flatten_relief
tools.title: Flatten thick paint
tools.description: Removes a layer’s relief and material (gloss, metallic): the paint keeps its colour but lies flat. One undo step. Returns the layer id and whether anything was flattened.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: set_instant_dry
tools.title: Dry wet strokes at once
tools.description: Switches instant drying: on, every wet stroke (watercolour, gouache, oil) dries as soon as it ends, in the same undo step, so strokes stay exactly where they are laid; off (default), wet paint keeps moving until it dries. Editor state. Returns instantDry.

on.description: true dries every wet stroke as it ends.

tools.name: set_uv_light
tools.title: Set UV blacklight
tools.description: Switches the virtual UV blacklight (on) and sets its glow strength (0..2, default 1) and ambient daylight level (0..1, default 0.15). When on, the paper and daylight paint dim to ambient and fluorescent strokes (fluorescence.amount > 0, including invisible UV ink) glow and spill in their own colour. Saved with the document, not an undo step. Returns the UV light settings and fluorescentLayerIds.

on.description: Whether the UV blacklight is switched on (default false).

ambient.description: How much normal daylight remains under UV, 0 (pitch dark) .. 1 (full daylight, default 0.15).

tools.name: get_uv_light
tools.title: Read UV blacklight
tools.description: Reads the virtual UV blacklight settings (on, strength, ambient) and the ids of layers that hold UV-fluorescent ink (fluorescentLayerIds). Changes nothing.

tools.name: paint_heat
tools.title: Warm or cool the canvas
tools.description: Applies a heat brush along points on the document’s coarse heat field (radius in document pixels, default 24; temperature 0 cools .. 1 warms, default 1). Thermochromic strokes (thermochromic.hotColor) shift smoothly toward their hot colour where local temperature crosses their threshold, and wet paint under hot tiles (temperature >= 0.5) dries in place. One undo step. Returns the heat field stats (max, mean, hotCells, bounds) and any dried wet layers.

points.description: Polyline of document positions to warm or cool along.

radius.description: Heat falloff radius in document pixels, 1..512 (default 24).

temperature.description: Target temperature along the stroke, 0 (cool) .. 1 (hot, default 1).

tools.name: advance_heat
tools.title: Spread and cool heat
tools.description: Advances the document’s heat field by steps (1..200, default 10) of thermal diffusion and Newtonian cooling, so warm patches spread outward and fade back toward cold paint. Any wet paint under hot cells dries. Not an undo step (time passing never is). Returns steps, the updated heat stats (max, mean, hotCells, bounds) and any dried wet layers.

steps.description: Diffusion and cooling steps to run, 1..200 (default 10).

tools.name: clear_heat
tools.title: Cool the whole canvas
tools.description: Cools the entire document heat field back to 0 at once so all thermochromic paint returns to its cold colour. One undo step when the canvas was warm. Returns { cleared }.

tools.name: get_heat
tools.title: Read canvas heat
tools.description: Reads the document’s heat field stats (max, mean, hotCells, bounds), optional temperature samples (0..1) at points in document pixels, and thermochromicLayerIds. Changes nothing.

points.description: Optional document positions (px) at which to sample the local temperature (0..1).

tools.name: add_magnet
tools.title: Place a magnet
tools.description: Places a dipole magnet on the canvas at (x, y) in document pixels. Liquid ferrofluid on every layer gathers toward the magnet (deterministic advection steps) and rises into hexagonal Rosensweig relief spikes along the magnetic field lines wherever |B| exceeds the layer’s threshold, shaded live by set_lighting. One undo step. Returns the magnet (id, x, y, strength, radius).

x.description: Magnet centre x in document pixels.

y.description: Magnet centre y in document pixels.

strength.description: Dipole strength -1..1 (default 0.8; negative flips the pole).

tools.name: update_magnet
tools.title: Move or tune a magnet
tools.description: Moves a magnet or changes its dipole strength (-1..1) or falloff radius (4..2048 px) by id from list_magnets. Liquid ferrofluid gathers toward the updated field and the lit relief spikes update at once. One undo step. Returns the updated magnet.

x.description: Magnet centre x in document pixels.

y.description: Magnet centre y in document pixels.

tools.name: remove_magnets
tools.title: Remove magnets
tools.description: Removes magnets by id from list_magnets, or every magnet on the canvas when ids is omitted or empty. Uncured ferrofluid relaxes as the field changes; cured relief stays. One undo step. Returns the removed magnet ids.

ids.description: Magnet ids to remove (default: remove all magnets).

tools.name: list_magnets
tools.title: List magnets
tools.description: Lists the magnets placed on the canvas in order: id, x, y (document pixels), strength (-1..1) and radius (px). Changes nothing.

tools.name: get_ferrofluid
tools.title: Read a layer’s ferrofluid and spikes
tools.description: Reads a layer’s liquid ferrofluid (laid by brushes with ferro.amount above 0, such as ferrofluid and ferro-ink) and its live Rosensweig spikes under the current magnets: whether it has any (ferro), its bounds in document pixels, peak liquid level (0..255), liquid coverage in pixels, activeSpikeArea (pixels currently raised into spikes), maxSpikeHeight (0..255), magnetCount, and the layer’s capillary wavelength and threshold. Changes nothing.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

annotations.title: Read a layer’s ferrofluid and spikes

tools.name: cure_ferrofluid
tools.title: Cure ferrofluid into solid relief
tools.description: Cures a layer’s liquid ferrofluid: bakes its current magnetic Rosensweig spikes into the layer’s solid impasto height and dark glossy metallic material, and clears the liquid ferrofluid channel so moving or removing magnets no longer changes this layer. One undo step. Returns the layer id, whether anything was cured, the cured bounds, maxSpikeHeight and activeSpikeArea.

layerId.description: Pixel layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: export_time_lapse
tools.title: Export a time-lapse
tools.description: Repaints the painting from its recorded strokes and events (fills, clears, wet-media events at their clock) in a fresh editor and returns a time-lapse: frame count, fps, size, duration, a video project of the frames as stills (assets frame-0001.png…), and the ffmpeg command that renders it to timelapse.mp4 from the frame files (the video editor export path). Shows a contact sheet of a few frames. With includeFrames the frames come back as base64 PNGs too. Changes nothing. Layers with pixels that were not painted with recorded strokes (imported images, merges) start empty in the replay.

frames.description: About how many frames (default 120); one after every few strokes.

fps.description: Frames per second of the video (default 12).

maxSide.description: Longest side of each frame in pixels (default 720).

wetStepsPerFrame.description: While wet paint flows between strokes, a frame every this many simulation steps (default 60; 0 none).

holdMs.description: Hold the finished painting this long at the end, ms (default 1500).

includeFrames.description: Also return every frame as base64 PNG (large; default false).

tools.name: export_high_res
tools.title: Export at a higher resolution
tools.description: Repaints the painting from its recorded strokes at scale (2..8) times the size, with brush sizes, paper grain, fills and wet events scaled, so the export has real detail instead of upscaled pixels; wet paint is dried. Returns a PNG as base64 with its size. Changes nothing. Layers with pixels that were not painted with recorded strokes come out empty; the canvas may be at most 16384 px per side.

scale.description: How many times larger (e.g. 2 doubles width and height).

tools.name: breed_strokes
tools.title: Breed stroke variants
tools.description: Breeds mutated variants from 1..16 recorded strokes as pending paint proposals, generated one after another through previewPaint so each has its ghost over the canvas. Refuses unknown stroke ids and brushes that cannot be redrawn on their own (wet, impasto, sticker, eraser, blender, smudge, light or pickup brushes). Use get_proposal_genome to inspect a variant’s full stroke records, breed_proposal to evolve or cross variants further, and accept_paint_proposal (one undo step) or reject_paint_proposal to accept or dismiss one. Returns proposalIds and proposals (each with proposalId, title, seed, bounds in document pixels, diff and changes).

strokeIds.description: 1..16 stroke ids from list_strokes to breed variants from.

count.description: How many mutated variants to propose, 2..12 (default 4).

mutation.description: How strongly each part of a stroke genome mutates (each 0..1; 0 keeps that part unchanged).

geometry.description: Whole-stroke transform (move, scale, rotate, pressure scale) and smoothed point jitter along the path, 0..1 (default 0.35).

color.description: Perceptual colour drift in OKLCH lightness, chroma and hue, kept in sRGB gamut, 0..1 (default 0.35).

brush.description: Drift of each brush facet within its schema range, 0..1 (default 0.35).

seed.description: Reroll the stroke seed for dab jitter, scatter, bristles and particles, 0..1 (default 0.5; 0 keeps the seed).
Deterministic seed for the variants (default 1); the same seed gives the same genomes.

tools.name: breed_proposal
tools.title: Breed from paint proposals
tools.description: Breeds new stroke variants from pending paint proposals: pass one proposalId to mutate its stroke genome further, or two proposalIds to cross their genomes over (resampling points, mixing colours in OKLab/OKLCH and blending brush facets) and mutate the offspring. Generated one after another through previewPaint. Returns proposalIds and proposals (each with proposalId, title, seed, bounds in document pixels, diff and changes).

items.description: Pending proposal id from breed_strokes, breed_proposal or list_paint_proposals.

proposalIds.description: 1 proposal id to mutate it further, or 2 proposal ids to cross them over and mutate.

count.description: How many mutated variants to propose, 2..12 (default 4).

mutation.description: How strongly each part of a stroke genome mutates (each 0..1; 0 keeps that part unchanged).

geometry.description: Whole-stroke transform (move, scale, rotate, pressure scale) and smoothed point jitter along the path, 0..1 (default 0.35).

color.description: Perceptual colour drift in OKLCH lightness, chroma and hue, kept in sRGB gamut, 0..1 (default 0.35).

brush.description: Drift of each brush facet within its schema range, 0..1 (default 0.35).

seed.description: Reroll the stroke seed for dab jitter, scatter, bristles and particles, 0..1 (default 0.5; 0 keeps the seed).
Deterministic seed for the variants (default 1); the same seed gives the same genomes.

tools.name: get_proposal_genome
tools.title: Get a proposal’s stroke genome
tools.description: Returns a pending paint proposal’s full stroke records (id, layerId, facet brush, colour, points in document pixels, seed and optional copies, load, stencils and paint) plus its title and bounds. Read-only: changes nothing.

proposalId.description: Pending proposal id from breed_strokes, breed_proposal or list_paint_proposals.

tools.name: list_stickers
tools.title: List stickers
tools.description: Lists a layer’s stickers bottom first: id, ref (provider:id; stamp too for the editor’s own), x, y (centre, document pixels), size (diameter px), rotation (degrees clockwise), color, opacity. Empty for a layer without stickers. Changes nothing.

layerId.description: Sticker layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: sticker_at
tools.title: Find the sticker at a point
tools.description: Returns the top-most sticker under a point (document pixels) by its stamp’s shape, or sticker null when none is there, so you can pick one sticker among many similar ones before update_sticker, arrange_stickers or remove_stickers. Changes nothing.

layerId.description: Sticker layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

annotations.title: Find the sticker at a point

tools.name: add_stickers
tools.title: Place stickers
tools.description: Places stickers exactly where you say, on top of a sticker layer or onto an empty layer (which becomes a sticker layer): any sticker from the sticker library by ref (find_stickers), its art loaded first; tintable ones take color. Use it for deliberate placement; spray with paint_stroke and a sticker brush for a random scatter. An unknown ref is refused with the closest ones. One undo step. Returns the new stickers with their ids, for update_sticker, arrange_stickers and remove_stickers.

layerId.description: Sticker layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

stickers.description: The stickers to place, drawn in this order (later ones on top).

ref.description: The sticker: a ref provider:id from find_stickers (e.g. editor:star). Give ref or stamp.

stamp.description: Older form: an editor stamp (same as ref editor:<stamp>).

size.description: Diameter in pixels (default 48).

opacity.description: Opacity 0..1 (default 1).

seed.description: Texture seed (default from the new id); splat and confetti shapes vary with it.

tools.name: update_sticker
tools.title: Change a sticker
tools.description: Moves, turns, resizes, recolours, fades or restamps one sticker by id from list_stickers. One undo step. Returns the sticker.

layerId.description: Sticker layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

ref.description: Another sticker: a ref provider:id from find_stickers.

stamp.description: Older form: another editor stamp (same as ref editor:<stamp>).

size.description: Diameter in pixels.

opacity.description: Opacity 0..1.

tools.name: arrange_stickers
tools.title: Bring stickers forward or back
tools.description: Moves stickers to the top (front) or bottom (back) of their layer, keeping their order among themselves. One undo step. Returns the new order of ids.

layerId.description: Sticker layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

to.description: front: on top of the others; back: under them.

tools.name: remove_stickers
tools.title: Delete stickers
tools.description: Deletes stickers by id, or every sticker on the layer when ids is missing. One undo step. Returns the ids removed.

layerId.description: Sticker layer id from list_layers (default the active layer).

tools.name: list_mutations
tools.title: List pending mutations
tools.description: Lists mutation exchanges waiting for an agent (or all of them when includeAll is true): each with id, state ("settling" | "pending" | "claimed" | "answered" | "declined"), layerId, medium ("wet" | "dry"), bounds in document pixels, strokeCount, age in seconds, settle, patience and fade. Use an id with read_mutation or decline_mutation.

includeAll.description: Include settling, claimed, answered and declined mutations as well as pending ones (default false).

tools.name: read_mutation
tools.title: Read and claim a mutation
tools.description: Claims a mutation by id and starts its fade so the user’s stroke sinks away as you read it. Returns the mutation’s id, state ("claimed"), layerId, medium, bounds, fade duration in seconds, the strokes (id, color, brushId, brushName, size, points and bounds in document pixels), cropPng (base64 PNG and rect of the area around the strokes) and canvasPng (base64 PNG preview of the whole painting so you can choose where to answer). Refused if already claimed, answered or declined. Follow with answer_mutation or decline_mutation.

padding.description: Padding around the mutation bounds for cropPng, in document pixels (default 32).

maxSide.description: Longest side of the canvasPng preview in pixels (default 512).

tools.name: answer_mutation
tools.title: Answer a mutation with strokes
tools.description: Paints your answer to a claimed mutation (from read_mutation). Pass one or more strokes (each with points in document pixels, and optional brushId, brush facets, color, paint, layerId and seed). When a director is attached, your cursor glides across the canvas and paints live; all strokes commit as one undo step with origin agent:<id>. A second answer to the same mutation id is refused. Returns the mutation id, state ("answered"), layerId, new strokeIds, painted bounds and dab count.

strokes.description: The strokes that form the answer, painted in order as one undo step.

points.description: The path in document pixels (raw samples; the brush smooths them). One point paints one dab.

t.description: Time in milliseconds (optional; drives velocity dynamics).

tiltX.description: Pen tilt in degrees towards +x (Pointer Events tiltX).

tiltY.description: Pen tilt in degrees towards +y (Pointer Events tiltY).

altitude.description: Pen altitude in radians: 1.5708 upright, 0 lying flat (overrides tiltX / tiltY).

azimuth.description: Where the pen leans, radians clockwise from +x (with altitude).

twist.description: Barrel rotation in degrees (brushes with rotation barrel).

layerId.description: Layer id from list_layers for this stroke (default the answer layerId or the mutation layerId).

brushId.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (default the active brush).

brush.description: Facets to change for this stroke only, laid over brushId or the active brush (as set_brush takes them).

description.description: What the brush is for, in a sentence.

items.description: A tag: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

kind.description: mark: lays a material (see medium); tool: works on paint already down (see tool).

medium.description: Marks: what it lays. paint (dry, wet or thick), ink, dry (pencil, pastel, charcoal) or spray (airbrush). Descriptive: the tip, marks and behaviour decide how it renders.

variety.description: What kind of the medium: oil, watercolor, gouache, pencil, pastel, charcoal, airbrush, marker, highlighter… A wet brush whose variety is watercolor, gouache or oil paints that medium.

tool.description: Tools: eraser removes paint; blender mixes the colours under the tip; smudge drags paint along; water lays clear water (lifts dried paint with behaviour.wet.rewet); dryer dries wet paint; blow pushes water along; blot takes wet paint up; wet-blend evens out wet pigment; wet-drag drags wet paint.

tip.description: The tip: its shape and the dab it lays. In a patch, shape may be left out to keep it.

shape.description: round, flat, chisel: an ellipse set by roundness and angle (the name is for people); bristle: a tuft of bristles (see bristle); stamp: dabs shaped like a stamp, a sticker or an image source (see stamps), also laid as sprays, objects or particles.

size.description: Diameter in px (default 20).

hardness.description: Edge hardness, 0 soft .. 1 hard (default 1). Image-source stamps fade towards their edges below 1.

spacing.description: Dab spacing as a fraction of the diameter: 0.05 smooth, 1 dotted (default 0.1).

angle.description: Tip angle in degrees, counter-clockwise; added to the stroke direction or barrel with dynamics.rotation (default 0).

roundness.description: Roundness: 1 round (default), lower a flat ellipse (pastel, chisel).

opacity.description: Stroke opacity ceiling: overlapping dabs never exceed it (default 1).

flow.description: Build-up per dab towards the opacity: low flow builds softly, like an airbrush (default 1).

blend.description: How the stroke paints onto the layer (default normal). pigment mixes like real paint; multiply darkens like marker ink; watercolor glazes; tint, highlight and shadow recolour, light and shade.

bristle.description: Bristle tips: the tuft. Missing fields take their defaults.

count.description: Bristles in the tuft (default 32).

stiffness.description: Stiff bristles follow the tip; soft ones lag and bend into curves at turns (default 0.5).

splay.description: How far pressure spreads the tuft (default 0.5).

thickness.description: Each bristle's line width as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.06).

load.description: Paint per bristle: 1 never runs dry; lower, bristles run out along the stroke, a dry brush (default 0.6).

jitter.description: Random variation between bristles: length, paint, position (default 0.4).

items.description: A sticker ref provider:id (find_stickers lists them; the editor's own are editor:dot, editor:star, editor:heart, editor:leaf, editor:flower, editor:confetti, editor:splat, editor:sparkle, editor:ring), or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources lists them; add_brush_source makes one from an image). A bare editor stamp (star) means editor:star.

stamps.description: Stamp tips: stickers or image sources (source:<id>). Continuous dabs and sprays lay the first; objects take only stickers and pick one at random per mark (default editor:star; repeats count once); particles use the first 4 in marks.stampOrder, and repeats weight the order.

grain.description: Texture inside the tip (a grain source), separate from the paper's grain: each dab is multiplied by it. Continuous and scatter marks of round and stamp tips.

source.description: The texture: a built-in pattern (cold-pressed, hot-pressed, rough, vellum, laid, ingres, sanded, canvas, linen, gesso) or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources); light parts are peaks, which paint.

mode.description: texturised (default): the grain stays put on the canvas, a texture under the paint; moving: it rolls along with the tip, turning with it.

scale.description: Grain size: 1 is the pattern's or image's own size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How much the grain takes out of each dab: 0 none, 1 only the peaks paint (default 0.6).

contrast.description: Height contrast around the middle: below 1 softer, above 1 harsher (default 1).

marks.description: How the tip is laid along the path (default continuous): continuous dabs, a scatter of spray droplets, particles, or objects (editable stickers).

oneOf.description: Dabs laid along the path (the default).
A spray (a spray can): each dab lays a seeded scatter of droplets across the tip; jitter and size come from dynamics and the tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

size.description: Droplet size as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.12).

oneOf.description: Particles that move with the pen and draw as they go. Missing fields take their defaults.

physics.description: How the particles move (default spring). string: strands dragged behind the pen (hair, fur); spring: on springs to the pen, overshooting; orbit: circling the pen (curls); flow: thrown into a swirling flow until they fade; elastic: links that stretch and snap back; fuzzy: winding strings waving out of step.

render.description: How they draw (default line). dot: a mark per step; line: a continuous line each; sequence: beads spaced along each path; ribbon: the band between neighbouring paths filled.

count.description: Particles (flow: thrown per tip of travel). Default 12.

size.description: Mark size as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its edge width (default 0.08).

spread.description: How far apart they start, as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its width (default 0.5).

stiffness.description: Spring, string and elastic stiffness: stiff follows closely, soft swings wide (default 0.4).

life.description: Flow particles: how long they live (default 0.5).

ribbonFill.description: Ribbon: fill opacity between the paths, relative to their edges (default 0.5; 0 only edges).

ribbonPairs.description: Ribbon: adjacent (default) joins each particle to its neighbour; first-last makes one band between the outermost two.

waveAmplitude.description: Wave: sideways swing as a fraction of the tip size (default 0: no wave).

waveLength.description: Wave: wavelength in px of pen travel (default 60).

wavePhaseJitter.description: Wave: how far out of step the particles' waves are; 0 in step, 1 random phases (default 0).

stampOrder.description: Stamp tips: sequence (default) uses the stamps in turn; random picks one per dot, seeded.

stampRotation.description: Stamp tips: follow turns each with its particle's motion; random (default); fixed uses the tip angle.

oneOf.description: Each mark stays an editable object (a sticker) on a sticker layer; needs a stamp tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

density.description: About density × 4 marks per tip diameter of travel; 0.25 ≈ one per diameter (default 0.4).

rotationJitter.description: Random turn as a fraction of ±180° (default 1).

scatter.description: How far from the path marks land, in tip diameters (default 0.5).

colourJitter.description: Random colour change: at 1 up to ±40° of hue and ±0.15 OKLab lightness (default 0.2).

dynamics.description: Pen feel: pressure, tilt, velocity, jitter, rotation and smoothing. Every amount 0 (off) .. 1 unless noted; missing fields take their defaults.

rotation.description: What turns the tip: fixed (tip.angle, default), stroke (direction of travel) or barrel (pen barrel rotation).

surface.description: dry (default): stays where it lands; wet: flows, pools and dries (see wet); thick: stands up in relief (see thick).

wet.description: Wet surface (watercolour, gouache, wet oil) and the wet tools. Missing fields take their defaults.

water.description: Wetness: water laid, 0.2 a damp brush .. 1 dripping (default 0.5).

thick.description: Thick surface (impasto: paint with relief, lit by the canvas lighting). Missing fields take their defaults.

tools.name: decline_mutation
